根據資料顯示，磁鐵大部份是鐵或鋼所製成。任何一塊磁鐵都有磁場，磁場可以穿透非磁性物質。磁鐵亦具有「同極相斥，異極相吸」的特性，磁浮列車就是一例，當兩個相同磁極相遇，互相排斥，使火車浮於半空，令行車速度加快，為人們節省時間。生活中，自助飲品購買機又是怎樣利用磁鐵分辨硬幣？要將道具蝴蝶停於空中，磁鐵起了甚麼奇妙作用？
這次「大世界 小知識」開始之前，主持姐姐問起四位參賽小朋友對龜的認知，眾人覺得龜有「爬得慢」、「可躲進龜殼中」等特點。首先要大家猜猜「盾臂龜」屬於甚麼品種，究竟牠是在陸上生活的「陸龜」，居住於海裡的「海龜」，還是水陸兩棲的「澤龜」？透過接下來的問題，各位還可認識到盾臂龜的食物與生活習性。紙盒配合細心製作，大家即可做出可愛的「企鵝信箱」，留意「小手指工作室」。
小丸子聽見若林說他曾經身處「雨雲的罅隙」，覺得很神奇，於是趁下雨天出外尋找，結果找不著更迷路。學校將有歌唱測驗，小丸子發現自己音準有誤，於是錄音翻聽，卻不自禁幻想自己成為大歌星。

水是由氫和氧兩種元素所組成，水的形態會隨著溫度而改變，當水遇熱會變成水蒸氣，遇冷又會變成冰，在常溫下，水是無色無味的透明液體。水有重量，所以會對周圍接觸到的物體產生壓力，這種壓力就是水壓。將水槍注滿水，水壓的大小跟射程又有甚麼關係？將小筲箕放在載著水的杯上，再蓋上膠片；按緊膠片，將杯倒轉，為甚麼小筲箕會滴水不漏？

水是由氫和氧兩種元素所組成，水的形態會隨著溫度而改變，當水遇熱會變成水蒸氣，遇冷又會變成冰，在常溫下，水是無色無味的透明液體。水有重量，所以會對周圍接觸到的物體產生壓力，這種壓力就是水壓。將水槍注滿水，水壓的大小跟射程又有甚麼關係？將小筲箕放在載著水的杯上，再蓋上膠片；按緊膠片，將杯倒轉，為甚麼小筲箕會滴水不漏？
大雄見家裡經濟財政緊絀，於是走去尋寶，多啦A夢知道後借他「尋寶機」和「飄浮噴霧」。大雄不小心害靜香的胸針掉進水塘，用過法寶「加醋減醋」後心生一計，但在前往水塘的路上遭遇諸多阻撓。

朱古力的味道與香氣，對小朋友而言十分吸引。但若要擔任朱古力品鑑師，就不能輕易把朱古力放進口。品嚐朱古力前，可先用眼睛、鼻子感受一下，放進口後亦不應過於咀嚼及吞下，而是要讓它慢慢溶化，覆蓋每個味蕾！嘉賓帶同三種口味的朱古力到來節目，讓大家學習品嚐方法，亦趁機拆開坊間對朱古力的誤解。朱古力本身是甚麼顏色？白朱古力不一定是絕對白色？另外，浩霆哥哥帶來有關鹽的實驗，教大家自製「汽水沙冰」與「創意彩鹽樽」。
小丸子、藤木和永澤看見長山和山根達成年初目標，覺得自己一事無成，於是嘗試回顧上半年尋找轉機。小丸子覺得媽媽老是阻礙自己去跟朋友，覺得媽媽是因為沒有朋友才心生嫉妒，因此故意留難。

能量是可以轉換的。根據資料顯示，有些物體受到擠壓的時候會變形，這個過程會儲存位能，當物體恢復原狀的時候，位能就會變成動能，令到物體回復原狀。好像射箭時，運動員拉弓，就會儲存位能，放手時，弓回復原狀，位能同時轉化為動能，將箭射出。儲存的位能越大，轉化動能亦會越大。所以弓拉得越大，箭便能射得越遠。利用能量轉換，可以用做出回力小罐子的遊戲，究竟怎樣用鐵罐和橡筋做出回力小罐子呢？

朱古力的味道與香氣，對小朋友而言十分吸引。但若要擔任朱古力品鑑師，就不能輕易把朱古力放進口。品嚐朱古力前，可先用眼睛、鼻子感受一下，放進口後亦不應過於咀嚼及吞下，而是要讓它慢慢溶化，覆蓋每個味蕾！嘉賓帶同三種口味的朱古力到來節目，讓大家學習品嚐方法，亦趁機拆開坊間對朱古力的誤解。朱古力本身是甚麼顏色？白朱古力不一定是絕對白色？另外，浩霆哥哥帶來有關鹽的實驗，教大家自製「汽水沙冰」與「創意彩鹽樽」。
小丸子、藤木和永澤看見長山和山根達成年初目標，覺得自己一事無成，於是嘗試回顧上半年尋找轉機。小丸子覺得媽媽老是阻礙自己去跟朋友，覺得媽媽是因為沒有朋友才心生嫉妒，因此故意留難。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
能量是可以轉換的。根據資料顯示，有些物體受到擠壓的時候會變形，這個過程會儲存位能，當物體恢復原狀的時候，位能就會變成動能，令到物體回復原狀。好像射箭時，運動員拉弓，就會儲存位能，放手時，弓回復原狀，位能同時轉化為動能，將箭射出。儲存的位能越大，轉化動能亦會越大。所以弓拉得越大，箭便能射得越遠。利用能量轉換，可以用做出回力小罐子的遊戲，究竟怎樣用鐵罐和橡筋做出回力小罐子呢？

小丸子、藤木和永澤看見長山和山根達成年初目標，覺得自己一事無成，於是嘗試回顧上半年尋找轉機。小丸子覺得媽媽老是阻礙自己去跟朋友，覺得媽媽是因為沒有朋友才心生嫉妒，因此故意留難。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
能量是可以轉換的。根據資料顯示，有些物體受到擠壓的時候會變形，這個過程會儲存位能，當物體恢復原狀的時候，位能就會變成動能，令到物體回復原狀。好像射箭時，運動員拉弓，就會儲存位能，放手時，弓回復原狀，位能同時轉化為動能，將箭射出。儲存的位能越大，轉化動能亦會越大。所以弓拉得越大，箭便能射得越遠。利用能量轉換，可以用做出回力小罐子的遊戲，究竟怎樣用鐵罐和橡筋做出回力小罐子呢？
氫氣球從杜拜出發，計劃環遊世界，大雄跟胖虎與小夫打賭，倘若旅程失敗便要捱打一百記拳頭。大雄打出全壘打，卻把小夫新買的棒球打進水裡，為了籌錢賠償，大雄把快樂回憶抵押給「記憶貸款」。

本集節目請來香港乒乓總會註冊教練羅燕慈，以及兩位學員為大家講解及示範乒乓球技術及步法。在「開心活力趣乒乓」的第一擊，羅教練教大家正手攻球和接下旋球的正確站姿、握球拍姿勢，以及步法。在第二和第三擊中，教練分別講解橫板撥球、正板橫打，以及推擋技術。羅教練也會從中傳授一些比賽時的戰術。另外，觀眾們可以透過「乒乓小百科」，了解到有關乒乓球桌的知識、球員的標準服飾、乒乓球的不同類別，以及乒乓球的計分法。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
阿烏魯把OMEGA的各種新科技帶到小祭家中，翌日小祭上學，英吉請阿烏魯到糖果店幫忙，後者建議轉型網店，認為更有效率，但英吉堅持與客人接觸，阿烏魯大惑不解，英吉告訴她是為了看見客人的笑容。

講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
運動員們都努力練習，力爭有好表現。近期，香港的游泳代表隊與馬術代表隊，在中國內地的比賽上取得佳績，為港增光。伴隨輕快的音樂，李睿晴、陳逸晞、張滋楹、黃天瑜帶來既合拍又可愛的舞蹈。她們還將拱橋、一字馬、前手翻等高難度動作融入表演中，獲主持們熱烈鼓掌。除了這次的「My Little Show」演出，她們還期望將來可「跳」出香港！另外，「小手指工作室」教大家把廢紙盒再用，製成有趣的「紙盒蒸汽火車」。

水由細小的水分子組成，分子間存在吸力，於水表面形成一塊有彈性、張力的薄膜，這就是表面張力。牙籤放在水面中央會慢慢靠向杯子邊緣，若要將其移回中間，只需加入水。因為加水時，水的表面微微彎曲，吸力比起水平面的時候大，水的表面張力亦較大，牙籤被張力吸引就會向中間移動。此外，在紙船尾端塗上洗潔精，紙船會自行向前開動，這現象和表面張力有甚麼關係？而水黽能夠浮在水面，甚至在水面滑行，又與水的表面張力有甚麼關係？

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Join Afrina, Hanna, Panda and friends on ZooMoo to play our fun game show, Whats The Difference?. Did you know whales, monkeys and scorpions all have tails, but that they use them to do different things? Or that snails, snakes and naked mole rats all use different senses when they cant see very well? Did you know that ostriches, penguins and owls all have feathers, but that their feathers are all different for different reasons? Play Whats The Difference? with the ZooMoo crew and discover why animals think its cool to be different!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello and Goomo in their super-hero guises Jammboman and Sidekickman create imaginary adventures that bring them face to face with Mina and Ongo who also wish to play super-heroes. It all becomes moot when the four super-hero wannabees are called into a real adventure: saving Rita who is stranded on a ledge over Jammbo Gorge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Goomo thinks Bello is his best friend. But, does Bello feel the same about him? epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The King is having a blast with his favorite Jelvis toy when Rita asks to play with it. King, who fancies himself a good sharer, let’s her. Rita must discover the best thing about toys; when you share them with others you have a lot more fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Rita finally gets close enough to a dodo to pet it---but only because it injured its foot. She takes the critter home, nursing it with affection and too much food. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: While exploring the musical nature of spring on Jammbo, Goomo realizes he has a fear of Burst into Song flowers. In search of a cure, Mina conducts a series of tests to help Goomo deal with his over the top reactions to the singing plants. In the end, Goomo realize that when you understand your fears, there is nothing scary at all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Goomo’s discovers a noisy Heavy Metal Rock music box which he thinks is awesome but drives everyone elso on Jammbo crazy. Something must be done! Bello and Mina fool Goomo with a magic trick that makes the box “disappear”.Without his Wamma Jamma box Goomo is distraught.Bello and Mina realize how important Goomo’s music is to him and make the box reappear.In the process Goomo realizes that its ok if they dont like his music, he has plenty of music boxes to satisfy everyone!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Due to King’s weird sleep habits, Queen kicks him out of the castle. Surrounded by dark shadows and unusual sounds, King quickly seeks refuge at Bello’s house, but they are a long way from a good night’s sleep.After a series of strange bedtime rituals, Bello’s finally understands the problem and helps King conquer his fear of the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Goomo falls asleep in the jellyberry grove.Nearby, King tries to open his soda bottle with a ridiculously powerful machine that ends up knocking over the jellyberry trees! Goomo wakes among the ruins horrified! He convinces himself that he is to blame! It’s up to Bello and Mina to gather clues that get the King to take responsibility for his actions and clear Goomo’s confused mind.

The tiny Queen must realize how the power is going to her head.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello and Goomo in their super-hero guises Jammboman and Sidekickman create imaginary adventures that bring them face to face with Mina and Ongo who also wish to play super-heroes. Rita must discover the best thing about toys; when you share them with others you have a lot more fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello is given a very important job---he’s put in charge of running the Music Factory! Though the Queen leaves the instruction manual, Bello ignores it. As soon as she goes off for a much needed rest, the whole operation goes way crazy. The poor dodos work hard to set things right, but without an informed boss disaster looms. Bello must learn, and fast, that preparation is the key to performing any job correctly!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jammbo’s in trouble! Its amazing music bubbles are full of trash and gunky goo. After a planet wide investigation, the King, Queen and kids realize that the junk in the bubbles is their own garbage! epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牧羊仙下凡向恩人張錦榮的後人張三郎酬恩，結果動了凡心，陷於情網，仙終決定與郎成親，惜產子後被天尊帶回天庭。郎子病危，仙鶴助郎傳書予仙，仙欲擅自下凡，遭天將阻撓，幸獲觀音特許，仙重回凡間，與郎一家團聚。
徐淑娟為家貧學生林小明與校長爭執，憤而辭職到孤兒院任院長，而明終被趕出校，淪為街童。娟與表哥李義將街童接到孤兒院，明為救院友致雙腳殘廢。娟答應隨義出國留學，義在歡送會上被孤兒們的歌聲感動，決與娟留下。
余潔貞與楊醒非欲結婚，非父要大事鋪張。二人為籌錢，貞往非公司應徵女職員。原來經理王仲庭藉請女職員為名，續弦為實。董事長陳漢松亦垂涎貞美色，貞周旋二人間，不勝煩擾，幸其兄與表妹調解，非父亦答應婚禮從簡。
（續上集）白雲飛受重傷得師父藍海萍相救，原來飛乃公主，因萍當日醉心武學，致令妻女分散。天龍鏢局勾結清兵，馬君武被蘇飛鳳之父打傷拋下山崖，鳳、飛為救武而與各派爭奪萬年火龜，惜火龜被萍搶去。飛以真元救武。

張國良娶賣身葬母的林秀琼為妾，琼誕子福興。良離家多年，其妻何媚娘與表哥有染，被興窺見，遭兩人合謀毒殺，並嫁禍於琼，還誣蔑琼與其兄林志芬有私情。良誤信媚娘，苦打二人成招。幸何父、相爺重審此案，還琼清白。
細路祥自幼與何大叔生活。一日，祥助飛刀李逃走，獲贈賊贓金鏈，叔遂將金鏈送回給洪百好，好為答謝二人，供祥讀書。惜祥無心向學，與李等壞人為伍。女工呂薇勸李改邪歸正，並送了一筆錢給叔，讓他帶祥回鄉過新生活。
富家女林秀麗因感寂寞，故當售貨員認識了何月英與其妹月華、李國強、鄭志發。後五人投考藝員，英、麗被取錄，麗更引來趙公子的追求，而與英等人疏遠。麗發現趙公子變心，幸得英等人對她關懷鼓勵，麗感動與眾人和好。
花飄零常被男友梵鈴王虐打，其妹白梅勸零離開王，惜被王發現書信，怒勒死零，並找梅索命。梅欣賞夢江南才華，兩人結婚當日，梅得知南與王乃孿生兄弟。王躲藏在南的車內，待南接梅返家途中發難，最終王失足墮崖身亡。
（續二集）馬君武被白雲飛所救，他感師妹、飛及蘇飛鳳皆對他情深義重，對三女難於取捨。藍小蝶找藍海萍報仇，飛道出其身世，化解他們父女之間的仇恨。天龍鏢局密謀將九大門派消滅，武與各派合力鋤奸，解除武林浩劫。

吳冠城為兒子蝦仔的將來，離開義學，讓蝦仔入讀名校。蝦仔即將生日，城為蝦仔辦生日會，豈料蝦仔的有錢同學嫌棄其家居環境，紛紛離去，幸好義學的同學來給蝦仔慶生，令蝦仔非常開心。城終於醒悟，讓蝦仔回義學讀書。
阿紅與表兄阿水充當富有人家與梁劍雲、燕萍兄妹相戀。梁父大寒看上紅，阿泉為錢訛稱紅願意下嫁。訂婚夜，梁妻突然出現，寒只好認紅為契女解圍。寒對紅未死心，故紅偕水向寒坦承與雲兄妹的關係，寒無奈答應四人婚事。
梅向函、朱老爺兩族人為爭奪河流擁有權大打出手，梅家不敵，邀周念明相助。明受臨終前的梁父所託解救被追殺的女兒小英，明答應。時張永尋至，三人一同上路。明勸阻兩族人不果，函更伺機暗殺朱，明不齒，遂為民除害。

張家被趙王誅殺，張世傑逃脫偷見愛人雲重鳳，惜被董藩王撞破，鳳為救傑假意答允董的婚事。傑逃至魏國，得公主高俠蘭相助攻趙報仇。傑羞辱鳳，鳳道出原委，傑知錯往殺敵。董叛國以雲母女要脅傑投降，蘭殺董勸父息戰。

薛平貴父臨終前告知貴乃王子，因受逼害而流落民間。相國千金王寶釧拋繡球選婿，貴接得繡球，釧不理父親反對嫁予貴。貴制服了紅鬃烈馬出征西涼，卻遭人陷害，幸轉輾成了西涼駙馬。多年後，貴終與父王相認，與釧團聚。
汽車經紀呂永康與播音員莊佩華有七名孩子，康的客戶陳經理夫婦仰慕華，聲言若華到訪他們家就會買車，事情卻給七小福搞砸。陳氏夫婦離港旅遊在即，臨行前欲聽華講故事，華因病失聲，幸七小福幕後代講，康終簽妥合約。
貧困的吳聚財重遇舊同學周日清，清邀財同當經紀為生，成為難兄難弟，還同時愛上鄧秀瑩。財得知清對瑩的心意後，甘願退出，並將佣金送贈二人作結婚之用。瑩提議將金錢來創業，最終清、財合辦「兄弟商店」，共創事業。

「無敵三劍」遭蒙面人殺害，三劍之一杜褒的遺孤杜諾長大後矢志為父報仇，期間結識追尋武林至寶「金匱秘笈」的小冥女及林珮。杜諾被人打傷，幸得邵振文盜得解藥相救。後杜諾找到秘笈，卻遭蒙面人暗算，掉下萬丈懸崖。
劉志德父病重，德被迫娶張家婢女麥小珠來沖喜。德只好與珠假裝夫婦，出城找珠愛人張家少爺振強，不料兩家母親也同行。德戀人黃笑顏驚聞德已婚，故意親近強來報復。珠向顏解釋，兩對情人各自成婚，並向家人坦白一切。
富家子左志輝與公司職員丁素秋相戀，奈何遭輝父拆散鴛鴦，還逼輝娶潘玉珍為妻。時秋懷有輝之骨肉，不久誕女小薇。多年後，輝偶遇薇，對她印象甚佳，欲收她為誼女，因而與秋重逢。珍守諾抽身離去，讓輝與秋母女團圓。

富翁馬孟俊因孫女小麗失蹤而大受打擊，施漢威拜託樣貌酷似麗的蔡婉華冒充麗，以安慰俊。在相處期間，華漸漸與俊產生親情。後來華的身分被揭穿，但原來俊早知悉一切，還決定收養華為孫女，並促成她與威的婚事。
陳建南因妻趙仲瑛忙於工作，不甘寂寞，借下屬王小江之名，另結識女友戴安娜。恰巧娜租住瑛家之房間，南為應付二女疲於奔命。瑛誤會娜與江拍拖，江被迫承認，因此更與女友分手。其後娜得知南的惡行，與江聯手教訓南。
王先生孤寒又好色，並冒充經理追求顧客許芝蘭，蘭戲弄王後得知他是未婚夫秉希之叔，且拒借錢給希，於是施計向王騙財。王妻得悉兩人約會趕往酒店，王為避妻逃往鄰房，雖幸而撞破亨利欲對女兒圖謀不軌，王則人財兩失。
（續上集）杜諾遭暗算掉下懸崖，幸大難不死，更遇上高人，獲傳授武功。原來暗算杜諾的蒙面人正是邵振文，他竟是杜諾殺父仇人五雷神君的徒弟，兩人狼狽為奸。杜諾得小冥女等人之助，最終成功手刃神君師徒，大仇得報。

施桂芬偶遇程持忠，得悉忠父文耀乃惡名昭彰之狀師，憤而離去。芬撞破嫂楊杏薇的姦情，遭誣陷殺兄，忠求耀代芬寫狀紙申冤。官員受薇所賄，耀父子申冤無門，幸得巡按明察為芬昭雪沉冤，薇與姦夫伏法，忠、芬喜成佳偶。
徐淑娟為家貧學生林小明與校長爭執，憤而辭職到孤兒院任院長，而明終被趕出校，淪為街童。娟與表哥李義將街童接到孤兒院，明為救院友致雙腳殘廢。娟答應隨義出國留學，義在歡送會上被孤兒們的歌聲感動，決與娟留下。
阿妙被偷銀両而欠飯錢，幸得周添幫忙，並收留在周家打工。添女兒秀嫻與徐季良有婚約，良要與嫻相見才成婚，但嫻因病變成啞巴，妙遂獻計代嫻說話。結婚日，良得悉被騙，大怒。嫻病倒竟因此恢復說話能力，並與良和好。
李霜萍遭退婚後，與表弟張雲生相戀，卻遭張母反對，時萍已懷有生的骨肉，仍無奈嫁予莫仲良，不久良意外身亡。生重遇舊同學莫錦霞，並暫住莫家，得以與萍相見。霞雖暗戀生，但她得悉生與萍的關係後，決助二人續前緣。
方繼祖父親被奸臣殺害，忠僕吳璧帶同祖夫婦投靠其弟吳璞。徐勝挑撥是非，璞為自保誤殺祖夫婦，二人遺下龍鳳胎。龍竹與靈潔學成下山為父母報仇，璧之女玉燕四出尋武林好友調解，惜竹兄妹誓不罷休，璧終自盡了斷恩怨。

東宮娘娘林瓊玉身懷齊昭王的骨肉，遭西宮陷害而流亡，她途中產子後與子失散。民女萬里紅與昭王有枕藉之親後身懷帝裔，惜孩兒夭折，她後來拾得太子，認他作親兒，獲昭王封為東宮。多年後，玉與子重遇，誓要與紅爭子。
陳火被四眼張陷害入獄，出獄前夕，火妻病逝，臨終前託杜仲文照顧子女阿蘭及洪仔。火出獄後不敢與子女相認，但對他們照顧有加。洪患急症，蘭為醫藥費及還債賣身，火為救子女，助張行竊，後雖與子女相認，卻難逃法網。
錢麗英繼承千萬遺產後，吩咐秘書錢嬌假扮自己代為應酬。汪財逼兒子汪忠追求英，希望得到資金周轉。忠與真正的英邂逅，一見鍾情，卻被財棒打鴛鴦。忠與嬌結婚日，驚見英任伴娘，禮成後，忠與財方知一切，財悔不當初。
陳玲、周大海、李明、亞全以行騙為生，玲對此生涯感厭倦，於是海提出要她誘騙慈善家謝雲，成功後便可收手。玲以美色吸引雲，讓雲對她展開熱烈追求，後雲更向玲求婚。玲為了離隊，遂讓全及明假扮其父母，騙取雲金錢。
黃飛鴻因徒弟凌雲階闖禍，兩人改名換姓逃亡至廣西，並分別認識了莫文鳳、莫文兒兩姊妹。一次，階打傷鳳之兄長，鳳父莫天豹大怒，相約階比武，階落敗受傷。後鳳、兒遭豹逼婚，鴻、階出手相助，將惡人懲治。

When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盂蘭時節,一位無視傳統的職場新人第一天上班即禍從口出,得罪了辦公樓裡的鬼魂。值夜班的過程中,連累同事們一同經歷了許多詭異事件,令他們重新反思自己的不敬行為和對神明的態度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次車禍後失憶的王人傑找到夜間警衛的工作。午夜,他準時抵達廢棄的大廈上班,卻發現三隻冤魂如約而至,並揭發了一場復仇計畫。究竟這是命運的安排還是邪靈的詛咒?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深搖滾音樂唱片騎師Amy在擔任最後一次深宵節目主持期間,被一隻蝙蝠咬傷。一場暴風雨將Amy,她的神秘接班人和一位焦慮不安的工作人員困在小鎮的電台裡,在接近深宵時,情況變得更糟…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy gets bitten by a rabid bat during her last graveyard shift as a veteran punk rock disc jockey. When a storm traps Amy, her mysterious replacement and an anxious staff inside their small-town radio station, reality starts to distort as they go deeper into the graveyard shift…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靜雯是一名努力奮鬥的戲劇學生,為了應付學費開支而接受了一份模特兒的工作。然而,當她為一位專門從事表現性人體素描的神秘藝術家擔任模特兒時,靜雯意外地揭露了一個驚人真相,更將她推向生死邊緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個不斷以自己的標準審判別人的司機,總是用自己的方式默默為他人著想,試圖救贖一個又一個在他眼中的“受害者。當他心儀的女性朋友似被其兒子利用,他不惜擅行私刑,漸漸成為冷血的連環殺手…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤獨的阿振在工作中飽受同事的欺凌。當他選擇與由美一起度過生日時,朋友卻驚覺由美竟是一個充氣娃娃。阿振渴望有人陪伴,於是轉向網路,並找到了理想中的女孩米娜。米娜的出現徹底改變了他的生活,然而,當米娜的吸..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely Ah Zhen is bullied by his coworkers. When he spends his birthday with Yumi, his friends shockingly discover that Yumi is an inflatable doll. Seeking companionship, Ah Zhen turns to the internet and finds his ideal girl Mina. Her arrival transforms his life but a series of unexpected events unfold as her identity as a vampire is revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩個立志成為網紅的男生連同一位漂亮女同學,合力在學校後面的舊大樓拍一部靈異實錄片,希望能吸引更多關注。三人遇上校內霸凌同學的富二代男女。原來女同學早已有計劃接近這幾個學校霸凌,籍此展開一場不惜犧牲無辜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. The trio encounters a bullying gang and as events unfold, it becomes clear that the girl holds a personal grudge against the gang and is blinded by hatred to exercise justice, even if it means sacrificing the innocents…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深搖滾音樂唱片騎師Amy在擔任最後一次深宵節目主持期間,被一隻蝙蝠咬傷。一場暴風雨將Amy,她的神秘接班人和一位焦慮不安的工作人員困在小鎮的電台裡,在接近深宵時,情況變得更糟…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jas正與妹妹Laura享受著鄉郊的平靜假期,這份寧靜卻被一群突然出現的流浪漢徹底打破。Laura慘遭殺害後,Jas回到租來的小屋,發現妹妹冰冷的屍體。在悲慟與狂怒之中,她誓言追獵這群兇徒到底,定要其..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jass peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sisters murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。

Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jas正與妹妹Laura享受著鄉郊的平靜假期,這份寧靜卻被一群突然出現的流浪漢徹底打破。Laura慘遭殺害後,Jas回到租來的小屋,發現妹妹冰冷的屍體。在悲慟與狂怒之中,她誓言追獵這群兇徒到底,定要其..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jass peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sisters murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horrors haunt each family from within, and nothing is really as it seems.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天凌晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world descends into darkness when a sealed book, said to command the forces of the universe, is unearthed in an underground palace in the desert. As adventurers race to claim its power, the palace gates open, unleashing an unseen terror and heralding a catastrophe beyond imagination.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家決心撰寫一部暢銷小說來挽救自己的事業。他重返童年居所,這裡也是他成功作家父親神秘離世的地方。當他發現父親的最後手稿時,才意識到這部作品遠超出他的能力。因此,他決定抄襲這份作品,卻隨即..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer must write a hit novel to save his career. He retreats to his childhood home where his father, also a successful writer, died mysteriously. Upon discovering his fathers final manuscript, he realizes its far superior to anything he could create. He decides to plagiarize the work, setting off a series of horrifying events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world descends into darkness when a sealed book, said to command the forces of the universe, is unearthed in an underground palace in the desert. As adventurers race to claim its power, the palace gates open, unleashing an unseen terror and heralding a catastrophe beyond imagination.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家決心撰寫一部暢銷小說來挽救自己的事業。他重返童年居所,這裡也是他成功作家父親神秘離世的地方。當他發現父親的最後手稿時,才意識到這部作品遠超出他的能力。因此,他決定抄襲這份作品,卻隨即..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer must write a hit novel to save his career. He retreats to his childhood home where his father, also a successful writer, died mysteriously. Upon discovering his fathers final manuscript, he realizes its far superior to anything he could create. He decides to plagiarize the work, setting off a series of horrifying events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群漠視勸誡的年青人貿然闖進詭異森林露營作樂,入夜之後,他們內心的邪念驅使他們落入性與愛的關係陷阱,引來了森林裡一連串的靈異事件。黎明將至,他們當中有誰能逃生?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them.  When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 平靜的聖山村發生了一系列神秘事件,原本該下葬的屍體突然復活,而且拔足狂跑。全村馬上展開追查行動,但這時村中惡霸卻意外死亡,村長也失蹤。於是警察接手調查,但當謎底快要解開時,村幹部卻又有驚天大發現。到底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Olivia, an outstanding vampire romance novelist, longs to encounter a real vampire. Her wish comes true when Luke turns up at her remote snowbound cabin seeking for help. However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Lukes vampire companions track him down...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為逃離家暴陰影,Jennifer搬進212號公寓展開新生活,卻每天醒來身上出現詭異且疼痛的咬痕。她驚覺牆內潛藏著以活人血肉為食的古老寄生怪物。隨著襲擊加劇,面對這場嗜肉噩夢,她必須在被徹底蠶食之前,鼓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jas正與妹妹Laura享受著鄉郊的平靜假期,這份寧靜卻被一群突然出現的流浪漢徹底打破。Laura慘遭殺害後,Jas回到租來的小屋,發現妹妹冰冷的屍體。在悲慟與狂怒之中,她誓言追獵這群兇徒到底,定要其..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jass peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sisters murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為了解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李飛龍要出行送鏢,行前囑咐好友王天彪代照顧自己的鏢局及妻兒,不料,天彪竟先誘姦飛龍之妻子,後殺鏢局眾徒,更伏兵襲擊飛龍一行人等。飛龍死裏逃生,請師侄英傑往保護女兒燕娘...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一個耳熟能詳之中國民間神話故事,講述書生劉彥昌巧遇落入凡間的聖母三娘,二人一見鍾情,結下一段仙凡姻緣。但因與二郎神結怨,屢遭迫害,二郎神更將聖母壓在華山底下。彥昌與聖母之子沉香長大後,聞悉生母被壓華山,悲憤欲絕,藉神斧之助挫敗二郎神,劈山救母。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Lindas tragic suicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年譚東獨自從大陸來港投靠祖父,因與黑社會人物徐豪結怨而遭陷害,迫於無奈偷渡到三藩市。東在唐人街飯店覓得工作,後來又因打抱不平而再牽涉入黑幫恩怨中。東更重遇徐豪,二人展開連場惡戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fig

epg.programme_title_en: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 化學教師陳子風在一間保守的女校任教,與青梅竹馬的李海倫共事。陳在醫務所拾得棄嬰,後把棄嬰帶到學校照顧,卻被學生謠傳嬰孩乃陳與李之私生子。陳不但輕鬆面對,還將朝氣帶入校園,大受學生歡迎,李亦漸漸愛上陳。但保守派對陳之作風不滿,侍機剷除陳。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls’ high school, is stuck with a baby that isn’t his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太空科學研究深所獲悉有來自冰河時代的人類所化之怪物將會危及地球上的所有人類。這批怪物兇悍異常,神通廣大,大有霸佔整個世界的野心。為了對付這批怪物,科學研究所所長劉英德以自己數十年來的研究心得把勇敢的科學研究員雷馬製造成萬能超人。中國超人開始了與怪物的戰鬥……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有才華的女藝員蘭蘭與梅梅新加入「馬氏歌舞團」,蘭蘭與團主馬英不和。馬英在報紙匿名徵求女友,蘭蘭與他以匿名用書信往來,互生情愫。相約見面時,兩人膽怯退縮。歌舞團獲邀到日本表演,由馬英帶領,蘭蘭擔任女主角,二人的關係可否趁機會發展?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕劍客沈秉義受命出任愛國組織「日月會」總舵主,誓要討伐勾結外敵、禍國殃民的大將軍。在捨身報國的征途中,他先後邂逅豪爽女俠與兩位美若天仙的維族公主。面對國仇家恨與三段纏綿深情,這位劍客陷入了情義兩難的抉擇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the Sun and Moon secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and tw

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七十二家房客租住一幢舊式的庭院,終日受潑辣的女房東和她卑鄙的丈夫的欺壓。一名勇於發聲的新房客出現,改變了租客的命運。他們合力對抗逼遷、抵制貪警,最終成功不讓房東出售家園。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, defle

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄龍扮演的小李悄然回到愛侶故園之旁隱居,遙對窗中倩影,而不相見,直至發生危機,小李才露面相告,並且挺身赴難。有不少高手為爭“武林排名”而找小李決鬥,小李又要對付惡勢力龐大的幫主谷峰,於是小李找尋舊友阿飛相助,但阿飛被陰險美女林仙兒所迷,簡直變成廢人,小李於是揭破這女人的假面目,並且設法使阿飛振作起來
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of Shaw Studio’s highest grossing movies ever, this is the story of Li Chin Huan, the renowned, charming and sentimental swordsman who must fight many opponents, including an evil Clan Chief, for a place in the martial arts world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片講述了三個故事。《蕭翼賺蘭亭》講述唐太宗李世民收盡天下王羲之的書法,獨缺《蘭亭序》,御史蕭翼多才多藝,設計從辯才和尚那裡騙取《蘭亭序》......《蕙蓮》以林偉圖設計謀殺李鵬飛為序幕,以李在橋上看奇書《金瓶梅》展開劇情;而《小神仙》則又由偷牛、捉姦和小神仙同藥師之間的鬥法三個小故事組成。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 導演張堅庭在本片體現香港八十年代的大城小景;陳友與妻子惠英紅從大陸來港投靠父親,卻發現他並非如信中所言生活富足。東方之珠的美夢換來悲喜交集。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as City Lights

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展,兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯。白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀,江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角,老父回來見三位女兒成就,開心不已。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展,兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯。白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀,江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角,老父回來見三位女兒成就,開心不已。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家境富裕的大財主立帶男為填房,為了避免那不可靠的侄子奪取家產,他在病重前立下遺囑,更要求帶男將遺囑交給省城的另一侄子。當帶男這個年輕長輩遇上侄子及他的兒子時,更鬧出一連串的笑話。惠英紅更藉此奪第一屆香港電影金像獎影后。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this “young” auntie, the nephe

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魯俊谷、張權、於洋三人乃沙煲兄弟,三人合力獲得寶物「雙面神」,不料卻給胡起尾注,將三人毒殺,獨吞「雙面神」。劉永、梁家仁及梁韻蕊是他們的後人,在不打不相識之下重逢,為了完成亡父的遺志,三人齊心向胡偷回寶物。韻蕊早已混入胡家中,色誘胡之子,作為內應查出「雙面神」之收藏地點。永與家仁則扮鬼扮馬,偷天換日
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kid

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 范克在父親臨終時發現自己有一個同父異母的兄弟汶烈在泰國。於是,他去找汶烈,並發現他為了救治重病中的母親,而成為一名拳手。兩人相遇後,更被牽連在地下拳擊賭博當中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fan Ke discovers at his father’s deathbed that he has a half-brother, Wenlie, in Thailand. He goes to find Wenlie, who became a boxer to support his sick mother. Following their encounter, the two got involved in the underworld of boxing match gambli

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐僧師徒西行取經,受阻於烈火綿延的火焰山,唯有鐵扇公主的芭蕉扇方能滅火。然而因紅孩兒一事,牛魔王夫婦拒不相助。孫悟空遂與二人展開「三調芭蕉扇」的智勇較量。越過火焰山後,師徒不幸落入白骨精姐妹設下的長生圈套。面對詭計多端的妖精,悟空再施神通,護師脫險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fan’s fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 赤膽忠心的楊家將,世世代代為國而戰,子子孫孫為民而死,直戰到最後一員虎將楊宗保,不幸在金山之役中了埋伏,全營將士壯烈犧牲。楊宗保身負箭傷,被困金山,以身殉國。楊家滿門為保衛宋朝江山及替楊宗保報仇,在老祖母佘老太君的發起下,組成了一支楊家軍,誓與番邦周旋到底!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩大珠寶盜賊「夜來香」和「夜爵士」前往日本,意圖偷去「維納斯的眼淚」巨鑽。二人見面後即墜入愛河,卻不知道原來對方同為盜取巨鑽的競敵。最後誰會得到巨鑽?二人的戀情又會否無疾而終?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus’ Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will g

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清廷派人掃平少林寺,殺掉所有少林弟子。從中倖存出來的兩名弟子,分別拜入詠春及洪拳師傅門下,學習拳法。最終他們挾技擊敗敵人,並為死去師兄弟報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighter

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花花公子周國雄有一本「獵人日記」專門去記錄他四出獵艷的故事,周丟棄劉明華,又去追獵呂綺美,劉突然遭人殺死。後來周又去追求女學生朱麗珍…但當晚,呂遭殺死,警方向周追查。同時周想到和他親近的女人,一個一個的被殺死,嫌兇漸指向他,好像有人在陷害自己。周開始追查真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murd

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明皇身染惡疾,駕崩在即,卻無子可繼帝位;皇侄世子傑本可繼位,惜不成器,難當大任。皇弟徽王想起明皇曾與東宮宮女生有子女各一,現時藏匿于東陽縣,遂命锦衣衛劉玄平尋找公主與王子的下落。劉玄平路上屢遭世子傑爪牙追殺,幸得俠士來如風相助...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperors nephew hires assassins to kill the c

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李翰祥史詩式電影,藝術成就及導演功力震驚中港台三地。本片榮獲金馬優等劇情片、最佳女主角及最佳彩色影片美術設計獎項。影后盧燕飾慈禧太后;處女演出即成名的蕭瑤,飾死後受追封為貴妃的珍妃;而為珍妃逝世而不近女色的光緒帝則是狄龍。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon la

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,武義親王恃勢弄權,為奪紫光劍,不惜害死甘大雄、迫走徐牧,並命其子魯天霞率惡家奴直闖甘家堡,借弔祭為名,實以武力奪劍。甘氏三女勝男、亞男、超男惶然之際,表親徐進到訪,聯手殺退惡奴,但大戰中,徐進、勝男等受傷,無恙的亞男遂往飛虎嶺邀救兵……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu’s son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong’s three daughters. Eventually, Gan’s daughters team up with their cousin Xu to aveng

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 玉樓發現武館師傅封與妻子有著曖昧情愫後,最後更被傅封所殺。玉樓的弟弟小樓得悉兄長被殺後,誓要為兄報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou’s brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李修賢是一摩托車行東主,曾是著名車手,惟一次意外中傷殘;他對學徒麥德羅甚為賞識,麥因李之啟蒙而在澳門賽車中奪標。李聞悉麥參與非法賽車,予以規勸,惟麥受盛名之累,欲罷不能…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Dannys help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. A

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李修賢是一摩托車行東主,曾是著名車手,惟一次意外中傷殘;他對學徒麥德羅甚為賞識,麥因李之啟蒙而在澳門賽車中奪標。李聞悉麥參與非法賽車,予以規勸,惟麥受盛名之累,欲罷不能…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Dannys help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. A

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 玉面閻羅夏梧與司馬秋同為鏢局金婁文之義子,後司馬鏢因偷取兩本功夫秘笈而傷夏之臉,並將師父殺死;夏抱初生女兒逃走。夏抱女入山修練,並傳武藝予女兒玉面飛狐,命她出山向司馬劫鏢報仇。後飛狐遭司馬擒住,幸為書生徐繩所救。飛狐回山后,父疑心其與徐有私情,把她關在地窟中...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The formidable swordswoman Silver Fox was a child when her father was senselessly wounded by his step brother, and her mother raped. It is payback time eighteen years later, as her father trains her up with kung fu to take revenge on his behalf.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕貌美的丁芝華為緩解家中困境,與弟弟策劃了一場珠寶騙局,並打算將贓物帶往新加坡變賣。飛行途中,她為躲避海關查緝,急中生智將鑽戒塞進鄰座乘客張志賢身上,卻在出關後失去他的蹤影。無奈之下,芝華只得施展一連串笨拙又滑稽的計謀,試圖奪回戒指。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced t

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述,某寺青年僧人「瘋子」,性格瘋瘋癲癲,行為全不符僧人規範。該寺主持玄明方丈卻認為「瘋子」與佛有緣,並因應其性格與氣質,授以「癲羅漢拳」。「瘋子」有了武功後,動輒出拳傷人,方丈只得將其逐出寺門...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandits son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三十五歲的男教師林明娶了十七歲的女學生珍珍。兩人在同一學校上課,隱藏夫妻秘密。珍發覺林明常被女生包圍,而林又發現珍常被男老師追求,期間笑料百出。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 街頭浪蕩客孟剛與鐵虎雖玩世不恭,卻心懷俠義。一次偶然,孟剛結識革命軍首領萬泰,在其感召下,兩兄弟決心投身革命。在孟剛女友的協助下,他們成功潛入軍閥陣營,智取軍火送往前線。然而,在與軍閥的激戰中,三人相繼壯烈犧牲,成為湮沒於歷史中的「無名英雄」。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang’s girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce ba

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述飾花花公子的喬莊與好友楊帆,同時愛上胡燕妮,但楊成人之美。但喬因生殖力弱,故當胡懷孕時,就懷疑妻與楊有染…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. Davids sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沈冰紅幼時目擊父母遭高允及結拜弟兄殺害,雙腳更被凍至殘廢;長大後練就非凡武功,矢志復仇。後冰紅與高允次子高天英結識,天英雖知冰紅為報仇而來,卻對她的遭遇非常同情,主動為她治好腳疾……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her familys massacre yea

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 的士司機阿發與少女阿霞相愛已久,但發有神經錯亂,霞為除心理負擔,忍痛分手; 發大鬧霞家並斷指示真心,令霞感動而復合。然發卻不務正業,令霞甚為反感;一次爭執間,發狂性大發,霞流產,再次離開發...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕龍劍飛武功低劣,但在一次偶然的機會下,被火魂邪神古漢魂收為義子,並獲傳授八式如來神掌。龍劍飛從此脫胎換骨,成為武林高手。為報師仇,古漢魂命龍劍飛下山替他找仇人報仇,江湖風暴遂再牽起…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Battleship, Earth battles a powerful alien force across sea, sky, and land. Directed by Peter Berg and starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, and Rihanna, its explosive action at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了在一系列超級英雄電影宣告終結後重振自己的演藝事業,一名瘋狂的演員自編、自導、自演了一部百老匯舞台劇。沒想到,在首映禮上他試圖舉槍自盡後,這部戲竟然跌破眾人眼鏡地大獲成功

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位充滿希望的洛杉磯女演員與一位失憶女子結為好友。當她們共同尋找她身份的過程中,現實與幻覺交織,這是一場如夢似幻,關於野心、身份與好萊塢黑暗面的驚悚之旅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hopeful actress in Los Angeles befriends an amnesiac woman, and as they search for her identity, reality and illusion blur in a dreamlike thriller about ambition, identity, and Hollywoods dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一位前任 FBI 談判專家充滿行動力的故事。他發揮所有專業技能,試圖從在機上安置炸彈的恐怖分子手中,拯救一架飛往加州洛杉磯的噴射客機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An action filled account of an Ex FBI negotiator who uses all his skills to save a jumbo jet headed for Los Angeles California from the terrorists who have placed a bomb on board.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一位前任 FBI 談判專家充滿行動力的故事。他發揮所有專業技能,試圖從在機上安置炸彈的恐怖分子手中,拯救一架飛往加州洛杉磯的噴射客機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An action filled account of an Ex FBI negotiator who uses all his skills to save a jumbo jet headed for Los Angeles California from the terrorists who have placed a bomb on board.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席維斯・史特龍主演《???》,飾演一名失意英雄,在紐約市隧道崩塌之際,與時間賽跑營救受困通勤族。爆炸性的動作與懸疑氣氛,成就這部高風險災難驚悚片。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sylvester Stallone stars in Daylight as a fallen hero racing to rescue commuters trapped in a collapsing NYC tunnel. Explosive action and suspense power this high-stakes disaster thriller!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 導演克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)誠邀您進入《奧德賽》(The Odyssey)的世界。這部由他執導的神話動作史詩巨作改編自荷馬史詩,也是首部完全使用 IMAX 電影攝影機拍攝的電影。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Director Christopher Nolan invites you into the world of The Odyssey, his mythic action epic of Homer’s saga, and the first film shot entirely with IMAX Film Cameras.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名在越戰中陣亡的士兵多年後被改造成半人半機的超級戰士。然而,當記憶逐漸甦醒,他們掙脫束縛,在昔日戰友之間展開了一場殘酷的對決。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two soldiers killed in Vietnam are revived years later as cyborg super-soldiers. But when memories return, they break free—setting up a brutal showdown between former comrades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚-克勞德・范達美主演本片,由動作大師吳宇森執導,一場緊張刺激的生死追擊即將展開——他對抗一群以獵殺人類為娛樂的致命組織。聯合主演包括藍斯・亨里克森與威爾福・布利姆利。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this John Woo action thriller where a man battles a deadly group that hunts humans for sport. Also features Lance Henriksen and Wilford Brimley.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 第一次世界大戰期間,一名英國偷獵者、一名美國冒險家,以及他迷人的年輕女兒,聯手策劃摧毀一艘正在桑給巴爾外海灣進行維修的德國戰鬥巡洋艦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During World War One, an English poacher, an American adventurer, and his attractive young daughter set out to destroy a German battle-cruiser awaiting repairs in an inlet just off Zanzibar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名心智略顯遲緩的 20 歲青年以勞工維生,卻屢遭他人利用與欺負。某天,一位善良的 40 歲美國女子僱用了他,兩人逐漸建立起親密情誼。然而,小鎮居民與他的家人卻將她視為別有用心的掠奪者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A somewhat mentally handicapped 20-year-old man works as a laborer, but everyone abuses his naiveté. A nice 40-year-old American woman hires him one day and they become close. However, the town and his family see her as predatory.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After his partner Tom Wynne and family are killed by the infamous and elusive assassin Rogue (Jet Li), FBI agent Jack Crawford (Jason Statham) becomes obsessed with revenge as his world unravels into a vortex of guilt and betrayal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名自負的銷售主管為提升區域業績前往澳洲出差,卻意外捲入一連串性與職場糾葛的荒誕事件。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A smug sales executive treks to Australia to improve regional sales and becomes embroiled in sexual and professional shenanigans.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名落魄的德國水手在酒醉之下,同意駕船載送兩名英國女子從直布羅陀前往西印度群島,卻讓她們很快發現這趟航程絕不平順,唯有憑藉全部智慧才能活著抵達終點。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a washed-out German sailor in a drunken state agrees to take two British women from Gibraltar to the West Indies in his sailboat, they realize that it’s not going to be smooth sailing, and it will take all their wits to survive the trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A South African gold mine foreman is unwittingly manipulated by an unscrupulous gang of financiers who want to flood the mine to raise the price of gold on the world market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場前所未見的流星雨,讓一名科學家、他的助手以及一名陰謀論者察覺到一個巨大的掩蓋行動,以及一場更龐大的威脅——一顆正朝地球逼近、足以毀滅世界的隕石。他們必須爭分奪秒揭露真相,拯救地球。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Misanthropic worker Orson detests his lazy colleagues. He finds a secret, magical office that boosts his productivity and status, but his coworkers can’t see the room and grow to resent his success.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hopeful actress in Los Angeles befriends an amnesiac woman, and as they search for her identity, reality and illusion blur in a dreamlike thriller about ambition, identity, and Hollywoods dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Identical twins – a musician living in New York, and a mechanic living in Hong Kong – are separated in childhood but are unexpectedly reunited years later when the musician travels to Hong Kong for a concert.

Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在萊咖國政權交替之際,黑幫頭目宋邦企圖藉此洗白身份,欲坐上市長寶座。為了籌措龐大資金,他與官員勾結行賄,卻仍面臨嚴重的資金缺口。於是,宋邦的得力助手鄭吒和打手蘇萬殺人越貨、橫行作惡,逐步幫助他鞏固權力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Extreme Ends是個動作冒險真人秀節目,邀請四位名人及其特別嘉賓一同體驗香港的多元魅力!讓我們與兩位泰國藝人Gun和Ticha一起展開旅程,探索香港繁華的城市生活和幽靜的郊區。

Embark on the journey with two Thai artistes, Gun and Ticha, as they navigate the bustling city life and discover the serene outskirts of Hong Kong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕刺客青面修羅接受人生首份刺殺任務,同時暗中調查當年自己家族滅門慘案幕後起因。但任務還未完成,他發現自己已經捲入了一場策劃多年的陰謀當中,唯有利用自己的刺客技能,一一破局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武術宗師梁坤為保護心愛的女人毅然退隱江湖,不料他的隱忍卻換來了愛人的慘死。意識到宿命避無可避,他重返武林,在丐幫幫主蘇燦的鼎力相助下,梁坤殺出一條血路,誓要向那些冷血仇敵討回血債。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在萊咖國政權交替之際,黑幫頭目宋邦企圖藉此洗白身份,欲坐上市長寶座。為了籌措龐大資金,他與官員勾結行賄,卻仍面臨嚴重的資金缺口。於是,宋邦的得力助手鄭吒和打手蘇萬殺人越貨、橫行作惡,逐步幫助他鞏固權力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

A fatal duel has just begun!

Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,邪惡的黑羽會潛入了老邪神西城勇的地盤,盜走了修羅面具,而利用修羅面具放出當時只是個嬰兒的魔神。老邪神為了魔神日後不作惡收養了嬰兒,教他好好做人,成為小邪神。小邪神最後控制了面具的力量成為老邪..

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 真人秀節目The Ultimate BROcation,跟隨四位不同國家的藝人玩轉男人遊樂之旅 - 香港,盡情狂歡並展開瘋狂野性的冒險,為觀眾們帶來充滿男性狂野魅力的視聽享受!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hilarious reality show about four famous male celebrities from different countries on an all-expenses-paid fantasy vacation in Hong Kong, tailor-made for the “bros”!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒隊成員泰樺、老米、阿峰和阿棠共同參與抓捕毒梟的行動。然而,因黑警洩密,阿峰遇難,上司犧牲,阿棠也隨之消失。為了揭開真相,泰樺與老米在剿滅毒梟的過程中,必須在忠誠與背叛之間掙扎。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narcotics squad members—Tai Hua, Lao Mi, Ah Feng, and Ah Tang—are involved in arresting a drug lord. However, a betrayal within the police leads to the deaths of Ah Feng and his superior, while Ah Tang vanishes. As Tai Hua and Lao Mi uncover the truth, they find themselves torn between loyalty and betrayal in their fight against the drug cartel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Ball是個韓國體育運動真人秀。節目邀請了韓國Iron Squad的特種部隊迎接一項新挑戰 — 閃避球。26名隊員將展開激烈角逐,直至選出一隊具超凡運動體能和最強心理素質的隊伍。在明星運動員..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sports entertainment show brings the best special forces from Iron Squad to take on a new challenge – dodgeball. The 26 players will enter a fierce competition, until a strongest team armed with powerful athletic endurance and mental strength is formed. Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義父慘遭紅花會叛徒殺害,方世玉立誓要追兇復仇。悲痛與忠義驅使下,他毅然挺身對抗陰謀叛黨,掀起一場冷酷無情的正義之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After Fong Sai-Yuk’s adoptive father is murdered by traitors of the Red Flower Society, he vows to hunt them down and avenge his death. Driven by grief and loyalty, he rises against the conspirators in a ruthless fight for justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東州地區長期盤踞一支販毒集團。霹靂女子突擊隊隊員梅靜率領其他隊員成功攻入販毒集團的制毒基地,卻中了預先設下的埋伏,梅爸爸是犯罪集團內部的臥底身份亦隨之暴露。最後,梅靜與突擊隊員們經歷一輪激戰後,擊敗對..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地下拳手林楓因拒絕替曼谷黑幫打黑拳,因此被追殺。他雖成功逃脫,卻失去記憶。當林楓開展其新生活時,卻被黑幫發現行蹤,並找來絕頂打手對付他。期間林楓忽然回復記憶,並誓要將黑幫殲滅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武松因發現他的嫂子潘金蓮與富家子弟西門慶有染,而被西門慶設計將他流放一年,在此期間,他的哥哥武大郎不幸被殺並火化下葬。武松回家後,告上公堂,誰知縣令三言兩語打回狀子,潦草結案。武松最終能否為哥哥報仇?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law’s affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother’s death?

Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 龍王被降龍大師封印了五百年,龍王之女為解除父親的封印,不惜穿越時空,回到五百年前殺掉降龍大師。但她沒想到五百年前的龍王與降龍大師竟是生死摯友…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

epg.programme_title_tc: Live and Die in East LA
epg.programme_title_en: Live and Die in East LA
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 急診醫生Attila救治一名車禍男童後,意外捲入洛杉磯東區的黑道糾紛。男童竟是黑幫頭目的兒子,而車禍則是預謀的幫派復仇。為救涉案的妹妹免於牢獄之災,Attila被迫成為黑幫的運毒棋子,由此引發一場血腥..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After treating a boy injured in a hit-and-run, ER doctor Attila is drawn into East L.A.’s underworld conflict. The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. To save his sister from prison, Attila becomes a drug courier, igniting a gang war that forces a tragic choice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一場發生在三國動盪時期的史詩式之旅。曹操試圖招攬關羽加入他的陣營,但關羽忠於他的結拜兄弟劉備,也是曹操的敵人。當關羽試圖從曹操手上救出劉備的小妾時,迫於無奈要大開殺戒。最後他能否殺出重圍?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩.當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動.每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow along as the wildlife rehab team works to treat a baby raccoon, separated from his family, and get him back in the wild before his parents move on. In another part of the center, watch as an orphaned killdeer is introduced to...himself?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨科學家團隊在雨季過後重新走入美洲豹領地,進行一次具規模的搜索,以尋找菲琳娜,菲拉和巴達洛,因為他們的追蹤項圈已經丟失.迎接一位生物學家加入團隊,在他的協助下,麗茲·戴利為美洲豹重新安裝追蹤項圈,並添置高科技設備以記錄更多數據.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rejoin the team for some post-rainy-season drama as they search for Ferinha, Fera, and Badalo, whose tracking collars are missing. Meet a new biologist who helps Lizzie recollar the jaguars, adding a high-tech device that will record even more data.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 經歷風暴,洪水和停電,莉茲和獸醫霍亞雷斯仍奮力為更多美洲豹戴上項圈,情勢相當緊張.一起尋找巴達洛的下落,並嘗試在追蹤標籤掉落之前找到他,以及拜訪一隻團隊渴望研究的新䧳豹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat as Lizzie and veterinarian Joares scramble to collar more jaguars amid storms, floods, and power outages. Try to pin down the elusive Badalo before his data-gathering tag drops off and meet a new female the team is eager to study.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷.和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞海岸附近,新生的座頭鯨吸了牠的第一口氣.牠身長16呎,是一個巨人,但未來的挑戰跟牠一樣巨大.在進行地球上最長的遷徙之一前,牠必須快點長大.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whales life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著松鼠猴的繁殖季節臨近,女強人艾巴必須帶領牠的團伙尋找食物,但男領袖撒母耳能奪得芳心嗎?年輕的沙奇拿迷了路,而敵人逐漸緊逼,局勢開始緊張.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where its mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎安娜的族群回到海濱灣, 那裡有兩個擅自闖入的水獭家族.當米婭嗅到安娜的氣味並將湯尼族群趕得遠遠的時候,牠感受到了壓力.然後,當遊牧族群對即將發生的衝突一無所知時,請抓緊時間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome Annas clan back to Marina Bay, where two otter families have been trespassing. Feel the heat when Mia catches Annas scent and hustles the Townies out of reach. Then hold tight as the Nomads remain blissfully unaware of the coming conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象中途之家 (Elephant Transit Home) 來了新成員:一隻生病的小象在自然保護區附近被拋棄,這是人類和大象爭奪空間下的又一個受害者.深入了解在普魯圖·費南多博士的領導下,如何以創新的方式努力結束這場衝突.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Theres a new arrival at the Elephant Transit Home: a sick elephant calf abandoned near a reserve, another victim in the battle for space between humans and elephants. Study the innovative efforts to end this conflict, led by Dr. Pruthu Fernando.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Brazils Serra da Capivara, Chico, the baby capuchin monkey is learning to integrate into a troop with complicated rules, and exploring a forest full of excitement and danger. But mastering the art of tool use holds the key to his survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the rescue team as they respond to a call about an opossum stuck in a fence that turns out not to be the kind of animal that plays dead. Inside the center, a goose with a serious foot injury receives physiotherapy before returning to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where its mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 撐過嬰兒期是地球上幾乎所有物種的最大挑戰.在非洲荒野,生死的平衡很容易傾側,動物必須成長並迅速學習,才能度過生命的第一階段.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For the first few weeks of life, the world is a frightening place. Danger lurks around every corner. It pays to be alert. Whether predator or prey. Any day might be your last. The race is on to grow up fast- for even the largest animals are vulner...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從撒哈拉到荒野,於極端環境中學習動物如何適應急速變化的氣候並掙扎求存.與黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避難,看看駱駝以特別技巧飲用鹽水,並傾聽斑胸草雀為蛋寶寶由唱的歌,了解歌聲如何讓幼雛變得細小.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起走訪迅速融化的極地,看看動物向科學家們留下有關我們未來存留的啟示與線索.了解北極熊,企鵝和其他極地生物的動靜如何幫助人類制定應對全球暖化之計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek to the planets quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨海灣族群的女族長,牠將遊牧族群永遠趕出了自己的領地,並發現了湯尼族群領袖米婭定居的令人驚訝的繁衍巢穴.隨後,牠們與紅樹林族群放鬆一下,與流浪狗嬉戲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the Bay Familys matriarch as she chases the Nomads out of her territory for good, and examine the surprising birthing den where the Townies leader, Mia, settles in. Then kick back with the Mangrove Family as they pal around with stray dogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘭卡獼猴隱藏在斯里蘭卡的森林中.作為島上的土生動物,這群活潑的群居猴子在世上獨一無二.牠們是有史以來最長的靈長類動物研究項目的核心.胡夫間鐵達時博士致力瞭解牠們複雜的社會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hidden in the jungles of Sri Lanka is the toque macaque. Endemic to the island, these feisty group-living monkeys are found nowhere else on earth. And they are at the heart of the longest primate research project ever undertaken. Dr Wolfgang Dittu...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞海岸附近,新生的座頭鯨吸了牠的第一口氣.牠身長16呎,是一個巨人,但未來的挑戰跟牠一樣巨大.在進行地球上最長的遷徙之一前,牠必須快點長大.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whales life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著松鼠猴的繁殖季節臨近,女強人艾巴必須帶領牠的團伙尋找食物,但男領袖撒母耳能奪得芳心嗎?年輕的沙奇拿迷了路,而敵人逐漸緊逼,局勢開始緊張.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where its mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨一群具有非凡能力的鯊魚,牠們可以在全球最惡劣的環境中繁衍生息.觀察在冰冷的北極水域生活,但幾乎失明的格林蘭鯊,以及另外一種能在陸地行走的物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從撒哈拉到荒野,於極端環境中學習動物如何適應急速變化的氣候並掙扎求存.與黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避難,看看駱駝以特別技巧飲用鹽水,並傾聽斑胸草雀為蛋寶寶由唱的歌,了解歌聲如何讓幼雛變得細小.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起走訪迅速融化的極地,看看動物向科學家們留下有關我們未來存留的啟示與線索.了解北極熊,企鵝和其他極地生物的動靜如何幫助人類制定應對全球暖化之計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek to the planets quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨海灣族群的女族長,牠將遊牧族群永遠趕出了自己的領地,並發現了湯尼族群領袖米婭定居的令人驚訝的繁衍巢穴.隨後,牠們與紅樹林族群放鬆一下,與流浪狗嬉戲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the Bay Familys matriarch as she chases the Nomads out of her territory for good, and examine the surprising birthing den where the Townies leader, Mia, settles in. Then kick back with the Mangrove Family as they pal around with stray dogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩.當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動.每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow an injured opossum into surgery, as the medical team realizes amputation may be the only way to save his badly injured toe. And meet some turtle hatchlings who seem ready for release when the team gets disappointing details about their size.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從撒哈拉到荒野,於極端環境中學習動物如何適應急速變化的氣候並掙扎求存.與黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避難,看看駱駝以特別技巧飲用鹽水,並傾聽斑胸草雀為蛋寶寶由唱的歌,了解歌聲如何讓幼雛變得細小.
