epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek to the planets quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 贊比亞的幼崽由成長至生育,皆面臨著巨大挑戰,每個教訓都意味著生死一線.牠們成年的過程需要技巧,力量,勇氣和大量的運氣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along t...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證無尾熊瑪拉進行攸關性命的牙科手術,然後與獸醫蒂姆一起評估受傷的滑翔鼠.與獸醫艾麗斯一起從排水溝中救出一隻狐蝠,並看看護士布里孵化的一窩蟒蛇蛋.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Brees clutch of python eggs hatch.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證救援人員如何使用「標記」的技術來追蹤一隻眼睛嚴重發炎的無尾熊,然後與獸醫蒂姆一起照料被燒傷的負鼠.接着跟隨獸醫卡琳娜檢查一隻險些被淹死的鴨嘴獸,再把牠轉介到專科醫生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 追隨安娜的步伐,到湯尼族群的巢穴去, 米婭和牠剛出生的幼崽便藏身於此.在族群搬到新的棲息地之前,看看小水獭們的第一堂游泳課,當紅樹林族群成為公園的主要景點時,將迎來一個水獭和平的時代.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chase Anna to the Townies lair, where Mia and her newborn pups are hiding out. See the babies first swimming lessons before the clan moves to new digs, and welcome an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a parks main attraction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明猩學園的一些學生正在發生巨大的變化,校內的猩猩孤兒學習牠們在野外生存所需的森林技能.四位新生加入了幼兒班,而一些熟悉的面孔則升了班. 對少數青年雄性來說,這是牠們畢業前的最後一天.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some big changes when four cute new arrivals join the nursery classes. And for a handful of adolescent males that are growing too big and boisterous for their babysitters, its their last day at forest school.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從撒哈拉到荒野,於極端環境中學習動物如何適應急速變化的氣候並掙扎求存.與黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避難,看看駱駝以特別技巧飲用鹽水,並傾聽斑胸草雀為蛋寶寶由唱的歌,了解歌聲如何讓幼雛變得細小.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證大白鯊群英的終極戰鬥!科學家們嘗試從新西蘭海岸外的100多條大白鯊中,挑選出領頭的鯊王.一起為群雄的速度,獵食技能和無比勇氣而喝采.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the ultimate battle for dominance as scientists try to pick out the alpha male in a pack of 100-plus great white sharks off the New Zealand coast. Marvel at the speed, hunting prowess, and fearlessness that determine the leader of the pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證救援人員如何使用「標記」的技術來追蹤一隻眼睛嚴重發炎的無尾熊,然後與獸醫蒂姆一起照料被燒傷的負鼠.接着跟隨獸醫卡琳娜檢查一隻險些被淹死的鴨嘴獸,再把牠轉介到專科醫生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 追隨安娜的步伐,到湯尼族群的巢穴去, 米婭和牠剛出生的幼崽便藏身於此.在族群搬到新的棲息地之前,看看小水獭們的第一堂游泳課,當紅樹林族群成為公園的主要景點時,將迎來一個水獭和平的時代.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chase Anna to the Townies lair, where Mia and her newborn pups are hiding out. See the babies first swimming lessons before the clan moves to new digs, and welcome an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a parks main attraction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明猩學園的一些學生正在發生巨大的變化,校內的猩猩孤兒學習牠們在野外生存所需的森林技能.四位新生加入了幼兒班,而一些熟悉的面孔則升了班. 對少數青年雄性來說,這是牠們畢業前的最後一天.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some big changes when four cute new arrivals join the nursery classes. And for a handful of adolescent males that are growing too big and boisterous for their babysitters, its their last day at forest school.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從撒哈拉到荒野,於極端環境中學習動物如何適應急速變化的氣候並掙扎求存.與黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避難,看看駱駝以特別技巧飲用鹽水,並傾聽斑胸草雀為蛋寶寶由唱的歌,了解歌聲如何讓幼雛變得細小.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起走訪迅速融化的極地,看看動物向科學家們留下有關我們未來存留的啟示與線索.了解北極熊,企鵝和其他極地生物的動靜如何幫助人類制定應對全球暖化之計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek to the planets quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證大白鯊群英的終極戰鬥!科學家們嘗試從新西蘭海岸外的100多條大白鯊中,挑選出領頭的鯊王.一起為群雄的速度,獵食技能和無比勇氣而喝采.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the ultimate battle for dominance as scientists try to pick out the alpha male in a pack of 100-plus great white sharks off the New Zealand coast. Marvel at the speed, hunting prowess, and fearlessness that determine the leader of the pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩.當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動.每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a flock of cedar waxwings who have taken over the centers aviary and are keeping the staff busy with endless demands for food. Then the rescue team works with the Ministry of Natural Resources to relocate a coyote thats too people-friendly.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證無尾熊瑪拉進行攸關性命的牙科手術,然後與獸醫蒂姆一起評估受傷的滑翔鼠.與獸醫艾麗斯一起從排水溝中救出一隻狐蝠,並看看護士布里孵化的一窩蟒蛇蛋.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了把基因傳承給下一代,動物在一生中歷盡史詩式的鬥爭.只有最強壯和最有決心的才能覓得伴侶,為交配而戰,也只有最優秀的父母才能擁有讓幼崽存活的技能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animals legacy. But its not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨阿納斯塔西亞的足跡,牠的象群因為保護兩隻珍貴的小象而兵分兩路,而獵豹庫萊塔則為牠剩下的幼崽奪回領地.塵土散去,雨水開始滋潤乾涸的大地,加入野狗菲尼克斯尋找新伴侶的旅程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenixs search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來到幕後,了解那些致力於保育與保護肯尼亞野生動物的創新團隊.看看「拯救大象」組織的無線電追蹤項圈系統,監測野狗群的無人機,以及當地的馬賽獵豹追蹤團隊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look behind the scenes and meet the innovative teams working to preserve and protect Kenyas wildlife. Check out Save the Elephants radio-tracking-collar system, a drone that monitors wild dog packs, and a local team of Maasai cheetah trackers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿,怪誕的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是明猩學園另一個戲劇性的一日!在幼兒班畢業後,是時候讓謝拉帕,他拉勤,巴彎和朗拿和牠們的同學一起來到全新的叢林教室.但驚喜的是,牠們回到幼兒班,舉辦一場盛大的聚會慶祝.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Crash a fruit-flinging party celebrating the return of Jelapat, Talaken, Bawan, and Rona to the nursery to join the rest of their classmates. Meanwhile, flooding overtakes the pre-release islands, and injuries stifle the progress of two students.

epg.programme_title_en: Boss Shark: Battle of the Sexes
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​目睹一場前所未有,獨特異常的鯊魚競賽,巨白鯊在令人瞠目結舌,驚心動魄的力量比拼中正面交鋒.與鯊魚專家萊利•艾略特博士(Riley Elliott)一起冒險,他努力回答這個古老問題:究竟哪一性別才是海中最強者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness a shark competition unlike any other, where great whites go head-to-head in jaw-dropping tests of strength. Risk it all with shark specialist Dr. Riley Elliott as he tries to answer an age-old question: Which sex reigns supreme?

epg.programme_title_en: Irelands Wild Islands with Eoin Warner 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從拉斯林島開始,不會飛的海鸠雌鳥躍躍欲試,金色的野兔迎接黎明的到來.前往托里看看姥鯊,海豚和瀕臨滅絕的長腳秧雞的愛情之舞.隨後在阿基爾島追逐可愛的愛爾蘭白鼬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Begin on Rathlin, where flightless guillemot chicks take a leap of faith and golden hares welcome the dawn. Head to Tory to see basking sharks, dolphins, and the endangered corncrakes dance of love. Then chase adorable Irish stoats across Achill.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the rescue team for a madcap chase after a red-tailed hawk. He may be unable to fly, but he sure can run! Then follow the recovery of a rare albino squirrel who cant walk, and see how the medical team ensures hell be ready for the wild again.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 儘管樹熊是澳洲最著名的動物,但牠們僅在國內東部和東南部地區被發現.雖然牠們生活在廣泛的森林中,從乾旱到熱帶到溫帶都可以,但牠們的群體經常被不宜的棲息地所隔離.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Despite being one of Australias best-known marsupials, koalas live only in the east and southeast parts of the continent. Learn how their lives and behaviors vary in these different regions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人多好辦事,放諸野外同樣適用.這就是眾多物種都選擇群居的原因.保護族群才能賴以生存.對於這些動物,保護代表隔離 - 從外界的威脅中找到庇護所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Theres strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, its the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival. For these animals, protection means isolation – finding sanctuary from the ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獅尾狒是一種稀有的猴子,只棲居於埃塞俄比亞塞米恩山脈之中,他們富有魅力,愛發出聲音,並經常處於熱情和對抗之間.觀察牠們如何面對棲息地萎縮的挑戰--以及彼此之間的鬥爭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The gelada is a rare monkey that lives in the Simien Mountains of Ethiopia. Theyre charismatic, vocal, and mix affection and confrontation. Watch as they face the challenges of their habitat-and each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 進入南非的荒野,近距離觀察這個大陸最容易被誤解的靈長類動物之一.跟人類一樣,這些靈長類動物具有獨特的個性,與家人和朋友都有著強烈的聯繫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the wilds of South Africa to get an intimate look into one of the continents most misunderstood primates. Like humans, these primates have unique personalities and share strong bonds with their families and friends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨着人類的活動範圍不斷擴張,非洲的狒狒必須適應求存.走訪整個非洲大陸,觀察牠們如何在面對家族存亡的關鍵時刻,形成牢不可破的社群連繫,並在不斷變化的環境中掙扎求存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As humans take up more space, the baboons of Africa must adapt. Travel across the continent to watch them form unbreakable social bonds, serve to protect their families and survive a changing landscape.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在坦桑尼亞海岸青翠的桑給巴爾島上,生活著一家紅疣猴.牠們是同類中僅存的一夥,被困在一個萎縮的天堂裡.在人口不斷增長的壓力下,他們稱牠們為「毒猴」,而且森林被外來物種入侵.如果小葉猴要適應牠的新世界,將需要新技巧和父母的知識.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Off the coast of Tanzania, baby Kima lives with his family of red Colobus monkeys. But what happens when he loses his way? Discover how this little monkey learns to adapt to life in the jungle-and find out if he can reconnect with his family again.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從編織鳥利用細長草莖構築精巧複雜的巢穴,到成千上萬的白蟻群體共同築起高達十英尺的土塔,盧安瓜河谷中種類繁多的動物群不僅展現了驚人的本能與勞動,也共同形塑出這片錯綜複雜,生機盎然的生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From weaver birds that create intricate nests with strands of grass to swarms of tiny termites that build towers ten feet high, see how Luangwa Valleys diverse array of animals sculpt their complex ecosystem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 準備好在濱海灣的鬥毆吧,在安娜和她的海濱家族遠在上游時,游牧人和城裡人家族佔領了她的領地.在這個海灣的合法主人突然返回之前,暫時享受一下這個豪華水道中平靜的水瀨生活吧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get ready to rumble in Marina Bay, where the Nomads and Townies are squatting while Anna and the Bay Family are away upriver. Soak up the peaceful otter life in this luxurious waterway before the surprise early return of its rightful owners.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎安娜的族群回到海濱灣, 那裡有兩個擅自闖入的水獭家族.當米婭嗅到安娜的氣味並將湯尼族群趕得遠遠的時候,牠感受到了壓力.然後,當遊牧族群對即將發生的衝突一無所知時,請抓緊時間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome Annas clan back to Marina Bay, where two otter families have been trespassing. Feel the heat when Mia catches Annas scent and hustles the Townies out of reach. Then hold tight as the Nomads remain blissfully unaware of the coming conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨海灣族群的女族長,牠將遊牧族群永遠趕出了自己的領地,並發現了湯尼族群領袖米婭定居的令人驚訝的繁衍巢穴.隨後,牠們與紅樹林族群放鬆一下,與流浪狗嬉戲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the Bay Familys matriarch as she chases the Nomads out of her territory for good, and examine the surprising birthing den where the Townies leader, Mia, settles in. Then kick back with the Mangrove Family as they pal around with stray dogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 追隨安娜的步伐,到湯尼族群的巢穴去, 米婭和牠剛出生的幼崽便藏身於此.在族群搬到新的棲息地之前,看看小水獭們的第一堂游泳課,當紅樹林族群成為公園的主要景點時,將迎來一個水獭和平的時代.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chase Anna to the Townies lair, where Mia and her newborn pups are hiding out. See the babies first swimming lessons before the clan moves to new digs, and welcome an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a parks main attraction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿,怪誕的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 踏上前往斯奈爾斯群島原始荒野的冒險之旅,這裡是一片遠離波濤洶湧大海的動物保護區.在這裡,與斯島黃眉企鵝群一起跳舞,與巨鹱和灰鹱一同翱翔,與巨型海獅一起咆哮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Venture to the pristine wilderness of the Snares Islands, a remote animal sanctuary protected from the turbulent sea. Hop along with a colony of Snares crested penguins, soar with giant petrels and sooty shearwaters, and roar with giant sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啟程前往新西蘭的奧塔哥半島,這裡是瀕臨滅絕的海鳥與海洋哺乳動物的繁殖地.在這裡,能夠看到海獅,信天翁,紅嘴鷗,白頭燕鷗和仙鋸鹱求偶與繁衍生息的場景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set sail for New Zealands Otago Peninsula, a breeding refuge for endangered seabirds and marine mammals. Watch as sea lions, albatrosses, red-billed gulls, white-fronted terns, and fairy prions find mates, then nurture the next generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭南島的頂部,你會發現一片兩極對立的土地,這裡是世界上最長的沙洲其中之一,吸引著斑尾塍鹬與飢餓的領航鯨,而淹沒的河谷為暗色斑紋海豚和新澳毛皮海獅提供了自助餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealands South Island, where one of the worlds longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales, and drowned river valleys provide a buffet for dusky dolphins and New Zealand fur seals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 告別熱帶地區,深入舒爽的南海岸水域.與威嚴的灰鯊,變化多端的墨魚和巨大的藍鯨相遇,並和企鵝和海獅一起玩樂.本集帶大家窺探這些海域蓬勃的生命力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters. Come face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish, and huge blue whales; play with penguins and sea lions; and learn why these seas are brimming with life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 旅程的最後一站,來到澳洲內陸沙漠與印度洋交匯處,探索一片炙熱的未知之境.跟隨莉茲深入海床,見證虎鯊,魔鬼魚和海龜如何應對生存威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Complete the trips final lap in the untamed lands where Australias interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索北領地的海岸和大堡礁豐富的水域資源.跟隨主持人莉茲穿越被淹沒的道路,碰見飢餓的鹽水鱷魚和水母,並查探眾多奇怪的致命生物為何會以這個偏遠地區為家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩.當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動.每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in with the centres resident turkey vulture, whos ready for release and in search of a flock. While Nathalie and her team rush to secure funding for a new facility, the medical team is baffled by a toad who has mysteriously taken ill.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 樹熊看起來是經常靜止不動和獨居的,但交配季節標誌著牠們行為上戲劇性的轉變,代表著更多走動,接觸和衝突.隨著維多利亞州奧特威海角的繁殖季節開始,我們跟隨正在準備交配的大型雄性洛奇和畢士打.對雌性來說,這可能是一個緊張時期,尤其是去年仍然年輕的小樹熊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Koalas may seem solitary and inert, but mating season brings a dramatic shift in their behavior, leading to movement, contact, and conflict. As breeding season begins, follow two large males on a mission to mate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 壯觀,刺激和累人的海陸空之旅是許多物種生活中的關鍵.這些王國為尋找食物,棲息地或伴侶而踏上旅途.但當這些計劃涉及數百甚至數千個體時,預訂和組織旅程就變得不容易了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Epic flights, adventurous sea journeys and exhausting road trips all play a key part in the lives of many species. These empires travel in search of food, shelter or a mate. But booking and organizing travel is no easy feat when those plans involv...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河發源于青藏高原,穿越中國雲南省,這是我們旅程的起點.儘管雲南只占中國不到4%的土地,但這裡卻是超過一半的鳥類和哺乳動物的家園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The source of the Mekong River is high up in the Tibetan plateau, from there it flows into Yunnan Province, China, where our journey begins. Even though Yunnan occupies less than 4% of Chinas land, it is home to over half of its birds and mammals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陡峭的山脈和熱帶季風塑造了湄公河流域的地貌,並一直延伸至老撾.一起探索這個豐富的生態系統,拜訪短尾獮猴,斑頂翡翠和黑冠長臂,並見證他們如何在這片福地上找到棲身之所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Steep mountains and tropical monsoons define the Mekong River valley on its route through Laos. Catch glimpses of the wildlife who find refuge in its vibrant ecosystems, from stump-tailed macaques to pied kingfishers to black-crested gibbons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於泰國的湄公河沿岸是溫帶與熱帶的交界;跟隨攝製隊沿着河流穿越金三角,欣賞該區眾多鳥類的求偶舞,再一同參與水靈祭典.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The temperate north meets the tropical south along the Mekongs banks in Thailand. Follow the river through the Golden Triangle and see the courtship dances of the regions abundant bird species. Then take in a festival honouring water spirits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索老撾甘蒙省壯麗的洞穴,這些位於湄公河和安南山脈之間的天然奇觀,是蝙蝠,壁虎,青蛙和巨型蜈蚣的棲身地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the stunning caves of Khammouane province in Laos. These natural wonders, squeezed between the Mekong River and the Annamite Range, are home to part-time and full-time residents, including bats, geckos, frogs, and giant centipedes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河沿著泰國東部邊境延伸,塑造了這片土地的地貌,形成數百條穿越叢林的小水道.走進這個巨大網絡之中,窺探恆河猴,大象和狐蝠如何在水邊和諧共處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the Mekong River travels down Thailands eastern border, it sculpts the land, creating hundreds of small waterways through the jungle. Take a trek though lands where rhesus macaques, elephants, and flying foxes live in harmony at the waters edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雅拉國家公園的森林是神祕懶熊的家.這種動物生性害羞,很少被看見及拍攝.加入野生動物影片製作團隊,跟著他們揭開前所未見的神祕懶熊生活和行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The forests of Yala National Park are home to the enigmatic sloth bear. Shy by nature, this animal is seldom seen and rarely filmed. Join a team of wildlife filmmakers as they reveal this mysterious bears life and behaviour as never seen before.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象中途之家 (Elephant Transit Home) 來了新成員:一隻生病的小象在自然保護區附近被拋棄,這是人類和大象爭奪空間下的又一個受害者.深入了解在普魯圖·費南多博士的領導下,如何以創新的方式努力結束這場衝突.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Theres a new arrival at the Elephant Transit Home: a sick elephant calf abandoned near a reserve, another victim in the battle for space between humans and elephants. Study the innovative efforts to end this conflict, led by Dr. Pruthu Fernando.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘭卡獼猴隱藏在斯里蘭卡的森林中.作為島上的土生動物,這群活潑的群居猴子在世上獨一無二.牠們是有史以來最長的靈長類動物研究項目的核心.胡夫間鐵達時博士致力瞭解牠們複雜的社會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hidden in the jungles of Sri Lanka is the toque macaque. Endemic to the island, these feisty group-living monkeys are found nowhere else on earth. And they are at the heart of the longest primate research project ever undertaken. Dr Wolfgang Dittu...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明猩學園的一些學生正在發生巨大的變化,校內的猩猩孤兒學習牠們在野外生存所需的森林技能.四位新生加入了幼兒班,而一些熟悉的面孔則升了班. 對少數青年雄性來說,這是牠們畢業前的最後一天.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some big changes when four cute new arrivals join the nursery classes. And for a handful of adolescent males that are growing too big and boisterous for their babysitters, its their last day at forest school.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是明猩學園另一個戲劇性的一日!在幼兒班畢業後,是時候讓謝拉帕,他拉勤,巴彎和朗拿和牠們的同學一起來到全新的叢林教室.但驚喜的是,牠們回到幼兒班,舉辦一場盛大的聚會慶祝.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Crash a fruit-flinging party celebrating the return of Jelapat, Talaken, Bawan, and Rona to the nursery to join the rest of their classmates. Meanwhile, flooding overtakes the pre-release islands, and injuries stifle the progress of two students.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 帛琉雖是一個小國,但卻大有故事.2009年,這個位於西太平洋中部的島國創造了世上第一個鯊魚保育區,以保護100多種鯊魚免受魯莽的過度捕撈和殘酷又商業化的魚翅製造業.而在2014年時,帛琉再次領先全球,建立了世上最大的海洋保育區 - 一個幾乎與加州面積相同的外國商業捕魚禁區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Palau is a tiny country with a big story. In 2009, this island nation in the middle of the western Pacific Ocean created the worlds first shark sanctuary to protect more than 100 shark species from reckless overfishing and the brutal practice of ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥斯達黎加的太平洋沿岸是一個生物多樣性熱點,擁有著近5000種海洋生物.但在這片海底森林中,海洋王者- 鯊魚因喪失棲息地和過捕而面臨著生命威脅.哥斯達黎加熱情的海洋防衞者現正聯手為這些瀕臨絕種的生物創造一個更安全的家園,並使牠們免於滅絕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Pacific coast of Costa Rica is a biodiversity hotspot that hosts nearly 5,000 species of marine life. But here in this undersea jungle, the oceans top predator is at risk. Discover how marine defenders are teaming up to save the shark.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫桑比克海岸以其巨人而聞名:從每年冬季到訪的座頭鯨到常駐該處的鯨鯊.但仔細觀察就可以發現一個很少被探索的微小物種的神秘世界.雖然經常被忽視,牠們對所居住的生態系統同樣重要.在這個野生和無法預測的海岸,海洋科學家們不惜一切地保護著莫桑比克最小的生物,免得為時已晚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The coast of Mozambique is home to giants, like humpbacks and whale sharks, but the tiniest species play just as big of a role in the ecosystem. Meet the scientists who are working against the clock to protect coastal creatures big and small.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在墨西哥瓜達盧普島附近,頂尖鯊魚生態學家莫利斯奧許尤士先使用遙視.他將攝影機安裝在大白鯊的鰭上,拍攝到一個獨特的視野,揭示牠如何游泳,狩獵,並且最終襲擊獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往巴哈馬的偏遠地區,解開鯊魚的秘密.牠們交友嗎?牠們在哪裡生育?有品種比其他大膽嗎?答案可能有助保護這些至高無上掠食者的後代.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to a remote part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets. Do they make friends? Where do they give birth? Are some bolder than others? The answers may help protect these supreme predators for generations to come.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海中最快的魚,尖吻鯖鯊通常是恆溫的,這使牠具有敏捷思維以及驚人速度的優勢.跟隨這種紐西蘭海岸附近相對未被研究的品種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks, and fight for the protection of these supreme predators – before its too late.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鯊魚經常被描繪成容易攻擊人類的無腦進食機器,但是它們的行為比之前所認為的更加複雜和聰明.找出這些優雅的頂級捕食者如何互動,選擇朋友,甚至訓導其他同類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每位巨人都由嬰孩開始.大象,犀牛,大猩猩和野牛都有動物王國中最可愛的嬰兒,牠們是小巨人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elephants, gorillas, rhinos, and bison are among the largest and most imposing land-dwelling mammals, but they all start out as helpless infants. See how babies from each species find their way to becoming giants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非,春天在九月初顯現端倪,大自然生氣盎然.白晝漸長,氣溫升高.萬物復蘇,生機勃勃.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Southern Africa, Spring starts in early September and the natural world stirs into life. Days begin to lengthen, temperatures rise, and animals and plants combine in an orchestrated effort to reproduce, give birth and raise their young.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是極端的季節,它劃分出了弱者與强者.它考驗著獵豹,獅子,壁虎,海龜和更多物種在酷熱的夏天尋找食物和水的生存本能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer in Africa is a season of extremes, it separates the weak from the strong. It tests the survival instincts of cheetahs, lions, geckos, turtles and many more species as they search for food and water in the extreme heat of summer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭南島的頂部,你會發現一片兩極對立的土地,這裡是世界上最長的沙洲其中之一,吸引著斑尾塍鹬與飢餓的領航鯨,而淹沒的河谷為暗色斑紋海豚和新澳毛皮海獅提供了自助餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealands South Island, where one of the worlds longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales, and drowned river valleys provide a buffet for dusky dolphins and New Zealand fur seals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證奧瑪法瑞團隊為新認識的䧳豹阿羅艾拉戴上項圈,並一瞥她的豹寶寶阿波羅.繼續追查巴達洛的落下,他似乎已深入森林;他的失蹤可能讓莉茲的突破性研究毀於一旦!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the Onçafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Auroras cub, Apolo. Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzies game-changing research in jeopardy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當家族中的雄獅都在探索鄰近的領土時,姆萬巴獅群中的狩獵責任就落在九位強壯的母獅身上.看看她們如何應對雨季的來臨,還要忙於照顧六隻不斷成長且胃口無限的幼獅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba prides nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷,強大的孟巴肯高獅群仍有17頭壯獅,但老化的雄性領導無以為繼.在北方,荷里活獅群中的六隻雌獅已經自給自足了三年,但沒有雄性與她們交配,可能導致族群滅絕.四名年輕流浪雄獅突然的造訪,似乎回應著荷里活獅群的祈禱.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the all-female Hollywood pride encounters the Nomads, a new pride of rival males, they may have found the answer to their mating dry spell. But they quickly realize that it will not be a happy encounter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4歲的班尼和娜娜因在森林裡發生了一次意外,班尼腿部骨折,娜娜肘部骨折,所以被收容在明猩學園的診所.不能走路並不能阻止「徘佪者」班尼,牠在房間裡拖動著身體,大聲要求牛奶和擁抱.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch a milestone moment when two students get their first forest time in years. And another pair of students are confined to the schools clinic after an accident in the forest leaves Beni with a broken leg and Lala with a broken elbow.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫桑比克海岸以其巨人而聞名:從每年冬季到訪的座頭鯨到常駐該處的鯨鯊.但仔細觀察就可以發現一個很少被探索的微小物種的神秘世界.雖然經常被忽視,牠們對所居住的生態系統同樣重要.在這個野生和無法預測的海岸,海洋科學家們不惜一切地保護著莫桑比克最小的生物,免得為時已晚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The coast of Mozambique is home to giants, like humpbacks and whale sharks, but the tiniest species play just as big of a role in the ecosystem. Meet the scientists who are working against the clock to protect coastal creatures big and small.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證奧瑪法瑞團隊為新認識的䧳豹阿羅艾拉戴上項圈,並一瞥她的豹寶寶阿波羅.繼續追查巴達洛的落下,他似乎已深入森林;他的失蹤可能讓莉茲的突破性研究毀於一旦!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the Onçafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Auroras cub, Apolo. Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzies game-changing research in jeopardy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當家族中的雄獅都在探索鄰近的領土時,姆萬巴獅群中的狩獵責任就落在九位強壯的母獅身上.看看她們如何應對雨季的來臨,還要忙於照顧六隻不斷成長且胃口無限的幼獅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba prides nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在動物王國中,大部分動物於出生時都無力自保.在溺愛牠們的母親監護下,牠們很快成為同類的主宰.本集的重點是動物王國中一些偉大的母親.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Not all infants in the animal kingdom get to have a good mother. But these are the stories of the lucky ones, from a ring-tailed lemur who learns everything from its mom to a tiny orangutan that receives a constant supply of motherly cuddles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證奧瑪法瑞團隊為新認識的䧳豹阿羅艾拉戴上項圈,並一瞥她的豹寶寶阿波羅.繼續追查巴達洛的落下,他似乎已深入森林;他的失蹤可能讓莉茲的突破性研究毀於一旦!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當家族中的雄獅都在探索鄰近的領土時,姆萬巴獅群中的狩獵責任就落在九位強壯的母獅身上.看看她們如何應對雨季的來臨,還要忙於照顧六隻不斷成長且胃口無限的幼獅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba prides nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在秘魯的山脈,一小群眼鏡熊為生存而戰.孤兒阿馬遜娜必須學會獨立.老去的東哥沒時間找到配偶,很難才能俘虜理想對象曹莉達.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #1 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識在喀拉哈里盆地合力確保共存的罕有合作者.瞭解大象族群與結果白相思樹的共生關係,貓鼬與吵鬧卷尾鳥的聯盟,以及更多一對對動物相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the unlikely collaborators working to ensure mutual survival in the Kalahari Basin. Learn of an elephant clans symbiotic link to fruiting anaboom trees, a meerkats alliance with a feisty drongo bird, and more flora-and-fauna odd couples.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷,荷里活獅群大難臨頭.流浪雄獅的侵襲使女族長阿華受了重傷.由於首領喪失能力,狩獵變得困難.在尋找獅子的過程中,阿森發現了一隻鬣狗幼崽,牠的母親去打獵時遺下牠.鬣狗與孟巴肯高獅群因爭奪一隻水牛的屍體而大打出手.彌敦收到驚喜:孟巴肯高獅群原來藏著更多的幼獅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hollywood pride reels after the Nomads brutal attack on their leader, Ava, leaves her desperately weak and unable to hunt. To add to her woes, her hungry pride start rejecting her. But without her, they struggle to bring down prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年幼的馬來熊丹尼和印第亞來到姊妹庇護所,那裡的一對朋友高寶和謝頓有著深厚的情誼.回到主樓中,診所的一個寧靜下午被兩隻猩猩突如其來的重病所打擾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Beni and Lala are going stir crazy in the sick bay, but they must recover before returning to the rough and tumble of class. And at forest school, a termite-foraging lesson inspires class clown Valentino to make a finger-licking discovery.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba prides nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在墨西哥瓜達盧普島附近,頂尖鯊魚生態學家莫利斯奧許尤士先使用遙視.他將攝影機安裝在大白鯊的鰭上,拍攝到一個獨特的視野,揭示牠如何游泳,狩獵,並且最終襲擊獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在秘魯的山脈,一小群眼鏡熊為生存而戰.孤兒阿馬遜娜必須學會獨立.老去的東哥沒時間找到配偶,很難才能俘虜理想對象曹莉達.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在印度,年幼獅尾猴華菲面對著不斷縮小的棲息地和人類世界的侵擾.幸運的是,他有一位慈母,一位防範的父親,一位淘氣的姐姐,以及眾多親戚都在看顧他.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In India, Ravi the baby lion-tailed macaque faces life in a shrinking habitat and encroaching human world. Luckily he has a caring mum, a protective dad, a playful sister, and numerous, cousins, aunts and uncles all watching over him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識在喀拉哈里盆地合力確保共存的罕有合作者.瞭解大象族群與結果白相思樹的共生關係,貓鼬與吵鬧卷尾鳥的聯盟,以及更多一對對動物相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the unlikely collaborators working to ensure mutual survival in the Kalahari Basin. Learn of an elephant clans symbiotic link to fruiting anaboom trees, a meerkats alliance with a feisty drongo bird, and more flora-and-fauna odd couples.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美,最壯觀的亞洲遺產濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmars most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明繼續他的日本烹飪之旅,準備新鮮的壽司,並前往妻子家鄉沉醉一些家鄉滋味.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his culinary tour of Japan, preparing fresh sushi and taking a trip to his wifes hometown to indulge in a little home cooking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明繼續他的日本烹飪朝聖之旅,品嚐一些最頂級的味噌,名古屋雞肉和和牛,並認識了一位年屆74歲的採鮑潛水員.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his culinary pilgrimage in Japan, devouring some of the finest miso, Nagoya chicken and Wagyu beef, and meeting a 74-year-old abalone diver.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在東京廣闊的城市版圖中探索一種飲食文化,它不僅維持了工薪族的風格,還保留了其烹飪傳統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the vast urban sprawl of Tokyo, Adam Liaw explores a food culture that not only sustains the `salaryman workers in style but retains culinary traditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明查訪了一些東京的瘋狂美食餐廳,品嚐了一些有趣的菜式,包括用雞的生殖器官製成的日式烤雞串.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw checks out the restaurants of food-crazy Tokyo and tastes some interesting dishes including Yakitori made from the reproductive organs of chickens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師,一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐,一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自60年前導演的處女作面世,馬丁史柯西斯一生一直致力為電影的過去,現在和未來打拼.他被稱為電影保母,他不斷突破電影製作的極限.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 60 years since his directorial debut, Martin Scorseses life has been dedicated to the past, present and future of cinema. Named Caretaker of Cinema, Martin Scorsese continues to push the boundaries of moviemaking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自90年代初,昆汀塔倫提諾一直乘坐從不減速的電影過山車,這也鞏固了他那世上最具影響力的電影製作人之一的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Since the early 1990s, Quentin Tarantino has been on a cinematic rollercoaster ride, that’s never looked like slowing down, that has cemented himself as one of the worlds most influential filmmakers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史派克李一直是位備受爭議和政治性的電影製作人,他的電影就是最好的證據.自40多年前處女作面世,他一直在美國突破界限.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spike Lee has always been a controversial and political filmmaker whose films speak for themselves. Over 40 years since his debut in the world of film, Spike continues to push boundaries in America.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在大西洋最北端,秋季是大風,涼意和大雨的季節.野生動物於此時必須為過冬做足最後準備,或遷移到溫暖的地區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Atlantics far north, autumn is the season of gales, cooling temperatures and driving rain. This is when the wildlife must make the final preparations for winter or migrate to warmer climes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪:小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南太平洋一個偏遠群島的叢林中,一位生物學家正嘗試做著查理斯達爾文和恩斯特邁爾的未竟之事: 在新物種創造過程中捕捉進化的身影.懷艾伯特在索羅門群島即將有一個驚人的發現,但一個危機慢慢逼近.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the jungles of a remote archipelago in the South Pacific, a biologist is attempting to do something Charles Darwin and Ernst Mayr never accomplished: catch evolution in the act of creating new species. Albert Uy is on the verge of an amazing disco

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來臨.北約克沼澤國家公園裡的動物必須尋找食物,配偶,並組織家庭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring comes to the Dales and North York Moors National Parks, the season when the parks animals must find food, a mate and raise a family.

epg.programme_title_en: Gameplay: The Story Of The Videogame Revolution
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《電腦遊戲:電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片.歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光.從《乓》到《食鬼》,《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》,《毀滅戰士》,《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gameplay is a feature on the history of videogames. From Pong to Pac Man, Super Mario to Lara Croft, Doom, Grand Theft Auto and beyond, we chronicle the remarkable story of the fastest evolving new media of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探索加密貨幣的基礎,並與當地冒著一切風險的加密貨幣先驅面談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we explore the foundations of Cryptocurrency and talk to the local crypto pioneers who risked it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在我們知道為何加密貨幣是何等大事,而我們在本集將認識紐西蘭最大的加密貨幣成功故事之一背後的家族.我們將破除一些加密神話並介紹如何參與的入門.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Now we know why Crypto is such a big deal, through this episode we』ll meet the family behind one of NZ’s biggest Crypto success stories. We』ll dispel some crypto myths and cover the basics of how to get on board.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執行長亞倫麥當勞和聯合創始人卜候活史密夫告訴我們他們如何在紐西蘭創立價值數百萬美元的非同質化代幣業務,並與國際巨星合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: CEO Aaron McDonald and Co-Founder Brooke Howard-Smith tell us how they created a multi-million dollar NFT business here in Aotearoa and are collaborating with international superstars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這裡擁有地中海一些最美麗的希臘神廟,似乎漂浮在海上的城市,還有地球上其中一個威力最大的火山,義大利這地區感覺就如平行世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With some of the most beautiful Greek temples on the Mediterranean, cities that just seem to float above the sea, and one of the most powerful volcanoes on Earth, this region of Italy feels like another world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來認識這些異常的微型動物,牠們利用嬌小的身軀在世上最致命的環境中克險求生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the extraordinary miniature animals, who use their small size to survive against all odds in the world’s most deadly environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 體型異常龐大的動物就需要異常的適應力.從巨大的鯨魚到森林怪物,這些就是自然巨人的史詩式生存故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extraordinarily large animals need extraordinary adaptations. From mighty whales to forest monsters, these are the epic survival stories of nature’s giants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師,一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐,一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力,溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往沖繩結束他的日本美食之旅,他在當地發現一道集大成的美食,並瞭解了長壽的秘訣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫南非美食之旅的第一站是繁華的開普敦.他在當地到訪熱鬧的農貿市場,並在 保卡烹調開普馬來咖哩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s first stop on his food trail of South Africa is the bustling city of Cape Town. Here, he visits a lively farmers market and cooks up a Cape Malay Curry in Bo Kaap.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫沿著南非海岸角繼續他的美食之旅,在抵達大森林私人自然保護區前,先到訪卡耶利沙黑人區,那裡是一些具啟發性的微型農業提案的集中地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren continues his food trail along South Africa’s Cape Coast, stopping off at the township of Khayelitsha, home to some inspiring micro-farming initiatives, before arriving at Grootbos Private Nature Reserve.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史派克李一直是位備受爭議和政治性的電影製作人,他的電影就是最好的證據.自40多年前處女作面世,他一直在美國突破界限.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spike Lee has always been a controversial and political filmmaker whose films speak for themselves. Over 40 years since his debut in the world of film, Spike continues to push boundaries in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片探討賀錦麗從早年加州的生活到成為首位美國女性副總統的崛起經過,她對美國政壇的影響以及她有望成為首位女總統的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary explores Kamala Harriss rise from her early life in California to becoming the first female Vice President of the United States, her impact on American politics, and her potential path to becoming the first female President.

epg.programme_title_tc: 克林伊斯威特:自得其樂
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇連伊士活是一個演員,導演和慈善家.從典型的西方偶像,到磨練他的技藝和關懷的個性.這就是他波瀾壯闊的人生故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Clint Eastwood, Actor, director and philanthropist. From being the quintessential western icon, to honing his artistic skills and caring persona. This is his magnificent story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑拉德在長達20多年的輝煌職業生涯中體驗並成功晉身球壇巔峰,作為球員和教練捧起過獎盃,又代表過國家隊.但有高山就會伴隨低谷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an illustrious professional career that spans over 20 years, Gerrard has experienced and succeeded at the pinnacle of the sport, lifting trophies as a player and manager, and representing his country. But with the highs, came the lows.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從山度士街頭到成為巴西隊頭號射手,內馬爾20年的歷程值得載入史冊.內馬爾幾乎在每個大洲都踢過足球,他將永遠成為球壇的傳說.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the streets of Santos to becoming Brazils number one goal scorer, the 20-year journey of Neymar is one for the history books. Having played football on nearly every continent, Neymar will go down as a legend of the game, forever.

epg.programme_title_en: Cristiano Ronaldo: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從年輕的葡萄牙神童開始見證有史以來最偉大的球員之一的旅程.這是絕無僅有的...基斯坦勞朗拿度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the journey from the young Portuguese prodigy to one of the greatest players of all time. This is the one and only...Cristiano Ronaldo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片帶領觀眾深入且全面地回顧萊昂內爾・梅西的非凡職業生涯--從阿根廷羅薩裡奧的平凡起點,到成為全球足球傳奇巨星的歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary offers an intimate and comprehensive journey through the extraordinary career of Lionel Messi - from his humble beginnings in Rosario, Argentina, to becoming a global football icon.

epg.programme_title_tc: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少有球員能像基利安・姆巴佩一樣,捕捉全球球迷的想像力.在短短十多年內,他從默默無名的新秀,迅速躍升為世界上最知名,最具影響力的足球明星之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從小鎮天才到世界第一,這部紀錄片記錄了穆雷追求卓越的堅持,與傷病的搏鬥,以及他作為網壇最具啟發性人物之一的永恆傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From a small-town prodigy to World No. 1, Andy Murray: Game Set Match chronicles his relentless pursuit of greatness, his battles with injury, and his enduring legacy as one of tenniss most inspiring figures.

epg.programme_title_tc: 克林伊斯威特:自得其樂
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇連伊士活是一個演員,導演和慈善家.從典型的西方偶像,到磨練他的技藝和關懷的個性.這就是他波瀾壯闊的人生故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Clint Eastwood, Actor, director and philanthropist. From being the quintessential western icon, to honing his artistic skills and caring persona. This is his magnificent story.

epg.programme_title_tc: 拉斐爾納達爾:紅土球王
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片深入探討網球傳奇拉斐爾納達爾的人生,探索他從神童成長為全球巨星的歷程.透過眾多勝利和挑戰揭示拿度在球場內外所貢獻的遺產.(V374)
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary delves into the life of tennis legend Rafael Nadal, exploring his journey from a young prodigy to a global icon. Through triumphs and challenges, it reveals the dedication that defines Nadal’s legacy on and off the court.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從地下俱樂部到全球巨星,《女神卡卡:為舞而生》探索這位重新定義音樂,時尚與名聲的流行偶像勢不可擋的崛起之路.在勝利與挫折交織的人生中,見證卡卡如何以舞步迎戰挑戰,並最終勝出.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From underground clubs to global superstardom, Lady Gaga: Dance or Die explores the unstoppable rise of the pop icon who redefined music, fashion, and fame. Through triumphs and tribulations, witness how Gaga danced through life’s challenges - and wo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑拉德在長達20多年的輝煌職業生涯中體驗並成功晉身球壇巔峰,作為球員和教練捧起過獎盃,又代表過國家隊.但有高山就會伴隨低谷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an illustrious professional career that spans over 20 years, Gerrard has experienced and succeeded at the pinnacle of the sport, lifting trophies as a player and manager, and representing his country. But with the highs, came the lows.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從山度士街頭到成為巴西隊頭號射手,內馬爾20年的歷程值得載入史冊.內馬爾幾乎在每個大洲都踢過足球,他將永遠成為球壇的傳說.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the streets of Santos to becoming Brazils number one goal scorer, the 20-year journey of Neymar is one for the history books. Having played football on nearly every continent, Neymar will go down as a legend of the game, forever.

epg.programme_title_en: Cristiano Ronaldo: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從年輕的葡萄牙神童開始見證有史以來最偉大的球員之一的旅程.這是絕無僅有的...基斯坦勞朗拿度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the journey from the young Portuguese prodigy to one of the greatest players of all time. This is the one and only...Cristiano Ronaldo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片帶領觀眾深入且全面地回顧萊昂內爾・梅西的非凡職業生涯--從阿根廷羅薩裡奧的平凡起點,到成為全球足球傳奇巨星的歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary offers an intimate and comprehensive journey through the extraordinary career of Lionel Messi - from his humble beginnings in Rosario, Argentina, to becoming a global football icon.

epg.programme_title_tc: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少有球員能像基利安・姆巴佩一樣,捕捉全球球迷的想像力.在短短十多年內,他從默默無名的新秀,迅速躍升為世界上最知名,最具影響力的足球明星之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從小鎮天才到世界第一,這部紀錄片記錄了穆雷追求卓越的堅持,與傷病的搏鬥,以及他作為網壇最具啟發性人物之一的永恆傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From a small-town prodigy to World No. 1, Andy Murray: Game Set Match chronicles his relentless pursuit of greatness, his battles with injury, and his enduring legacy as one of tenniss most inspiring figures.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片帶領觀眾深入且全面地回顧萊昂內爾・梅西的非凡職業生涯--從阿根廷羅薩裡奧的平凡起點,到成為全球足球傳奇巨星的歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary offers an intimate and comprehensive journey through the extraordinary career of Lionel Messi - from his humble beginnings in Rosario, Argentina, to becoming a global football icon.

epg.programme_title_tc: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少有球員能像基利安・姆巴佩一樣,捕捉全球球迷的想像力.在短短十多年內,他從默默無名的新秀,迅速躍升為世界上最知名,最具影響力的足球明星之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫南非美食之旅的第一站是繁華的開普敦.他在當地到訪熱鬧的農貿市場,並在 保卡烹調開普馬來咖哩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s first stop on his food trail of South Africa is the bustling city of Cape Town. Here, he visits a lively farmers market and cooks up a Cape Malay Curry in Bo Kaap.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫沿著南非海岸角繼續他的美食之旅,在抵達大森林私人自然保護區前,先到訪卡耶利沙黑人區,那裡是一些具啟發性的微型農業提案的集中地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren continues his food trail along South Africa’s Cape Coast, stopping off at the township of Khayelitsha, home to some inspiring micro-farming initiatives, before arriving at Grootbos Private Nature Reserve.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之旅的下一站是位於卡拉哈裡沙漠中心的提斯瓦魯豪華私人野生動物保護區.然後他遇到名廚馬努斯,烹製一些刺激的南非美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Tswalu Nature Reserve, in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. Warren then meets with acclaimed Chef Marnus to cook up some exciting South African delicacies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往沿海城市德班 - 住在標誌性的蠔盒酒店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the coastal city of Durban - where he’s staying at the iconic Oyster Box hotel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在德班,華倫先到訪著名的麥士生活品味餐廳,享受任性的祖魯烤肉體驗,再與當地導遊浮高碰面,參觀附近一條祖魯村莊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Durban, Warren visits the famous restaurant Max’s Lifestyle for an indulgent Shisa Nyama experience, before meeting with local guide Thoko to visit a nearby Zulu village.

epg.programme_title_en: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 且看廣告商如何利用新的樂觀主義和新科技在貪婪是美德時代裡大賣產品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how advertisers used a new optimism and new technology to sell big in the Greed is Good era.

epg.programme_title_en: Gameplay: The Story Of The Videogame Revolution
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《電腦遊戲:電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片.歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光.從《乓》到《食鬼》,《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》,《毀滅戰士》,《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gameplay is a feature on the history of videogames. From Pong to Pac Man, Super Mario to Lara Croft, Doom, Grand Theft Auto and beyond, we chronicle the remarkable story of the fastest evolving new media of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在法蘭史霍克山谷探索博殊真度紅酒莊的無盡產物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the Franschhoek Valley, exploring the endless bounty of Boschendal Wine Estate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫繼續從心出發,前往更鮮為人知的赫爾馬努斯小鎮,在當地參觀紐頓莊臣-風景優美的紅酒農場,從而加深對紅酒的熱愛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Continuing to listen to his heart, Warren deepens his love of wine by venturing to the lesser known town of Hermanus, where he』ll visit Newton Johnson, the 『wine farm with a view』.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫正離開開普敦前往西開普省更寧靜的沿海地區和風景如畫的帕特諾斯特小鎮.他在當地會驚嘆海邊村莊的氛圍,並沿著海灘騎電動單車.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is heading out of Cape Town into the more quiet coastal area of the Western Cape, and the picturesque town of Paternoster. It’s here he』ll marvel at the seaside village feel and take an e-bike ride along the beach.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 作為華倫南非美食之旅的最後一章,他回歸叢林,這是所有前往彩虹國度旅行的精髓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the final stanza in Warren’s Food Trail of South Africa, he’s back in the bush, a quintessential part of all travel to the rainbow nation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在世界著名的克魯格國家公園及附近開展第二趟南非美食之行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 約翰尼斯堡是探索南非的門戶城市!華倫在本集沉迷於深受當地人和遊客喜愛的桑頓區及周邊和精彩的國際口味.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johannesburg - the gateway city to exploring South Africa! In this episode Warren indulges in the vibrant international flavours and surrounds of the Sandton neighbourhood, loved by locals and visitors alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明尋找新加坡最好的海鮮.他從濱海灣金沙酒店出發,那裡有許多名廚開設的餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛頓熟食中心,繼續尋找海鮮靈感.他教授了如何安排一場獨一無二海鮮盛宴的大師班.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his search for seafood inspiration by heading to the famous Newton Food Centre. He gives a masterclass on how to line up a seafood feast like no other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從新加坡動物園的傳統早餐,包括咖央多士,溫泉蛋和咖啡開始,尋找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapores best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從地下俱樂部到全球巨星,《女神卡卡:為舞而生》探索這位重新定義音樂,時尚與名聲的流行偶像勢不可擋的崛起之路.在勝利與挫折交織的人生中,見證卡卡如何以舞步迎戰挑戰,並最終勝出.

epg.programme_title_tc: 瑪麗亞凱莉:毅力與魅力
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪麗亞.凱莉的人生宛如童話般的灰姑娘故事.至尊歌后,聖誕女王,熱心公益的慈善家--她已售出超過 2.2 億張唱片,並推出史上最暢銷的聖誕專輯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Cinderella story of sorts, Mariah Carey. Songbird Supreme. Queen of Christmas. Dedicated philanthropist. Mariah has sold over 220 million records and released the best-selling Christmas album ever.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅賓·威廉斯:笑容下的淚
epg.programme_title_en: Robin Williams: Laugh Until You Cry
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這位喜劇泰鬥有著令人驚嘆的頭腦,還有一系列讓我們嘖嘖稱奇的才華.他的故事激勵我們看穿那些看似擁有完美人生的人的面具. 他的精神將一直承傳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The comic genius with an electric mind, with a range of talent that left us breathless. His story inspires us to look past the mask of those people who seem to have a perfect life. His legacy lives on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明尋找新加坡最好的海鮮.他從濱海灣金沙酒店出發,那裡有許多名廚開設的餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛頓熟食中心,繼續尋找海鮮靈感.他教授了如何安排一場獨一無二海鮮盛宴的大師班.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his search for seafood inspiration by heading to the famous Newton Food Centre. He gives a masterclass on how to line up a seafood feast like no other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從新加坡動物園的傳統早餐,包括咖央多士,溫泉蛋和咖啡開始,尋找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapores best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來臨.北約克沼澤國家公園裡的動物必須尋找食物,配偶,並組織家庭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring comes to the Dales and North York Moors National Parks, the season when the parks animals must find food, a mate and raise a family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往沿海城市德班 - 住在標誌性的蠔盒酒店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the coastal city of Durban - where he’s staying at the iconic Oyster Box hotel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在德班,華倫先到訪著名的麥士生活品味餐廳,享受任性的祖魯烤肉體驗,再與當地導遊浮高碰面,參觀附近一條祖魯村莊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Durban, Warren visits the famous restaurant Max’s Lifestyle for an indulgent Shisa Nyama experience, before meeting with local guide Thoko to visit a nearby Zulu village.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之行的下一站是克魯格國家公園,南非其中一個最大的野生動物保護區,他住在著名的沙比沙比旅館.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa’s largest game reserves, where he’s staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在喀拉哈裡沙漠的中心發現無數的非洲動物,並學習製作傳統麵包乾來配早晨咖啡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Kalahari Desert, Warren spots a myriad of African animals, and learns to make traditional rusks to go with his morning coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫來到歷史名城普利托利亞,到訪當地農夫市集,與糕點師郎高斯一起製作扭麻條(南非糯冬甩).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren stops off at the historic city of Pretoria, where he visits the local farmers markets and cooks Koeksisters - South African sticky donuts - with Pastry Chef Nonkosi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在繁忙的約翰尼斯堡的第一站就是充滿活力的索維託小鎮.導遊仙迪帶他乘坐篤篤車 遊覽,並烹煮了他自己版本的一道南非素菜- 恰卡拉卡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the bustling city of Johannesburg, and his first stop is the vibrant township of Soweto. He’s taken on a tuk tuk tour by his guide Sindi, and cooks up his version of Chakalala, a South African vegetable relish.

epg.programme_title_en: Gameplay: The Story Of The Videogame Revolution
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《電腦遊戲:電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片.歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光.從《乓》到《食鬼》,《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》,《毀滅戰士》,《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gameplay is a feature on the history of videogames. From Pong to Pac Man, Super Mario to Lara Croft, Doom, Grand Theft Auto and beyond, we chronicle the remarkable story of the fastest evolving new media of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探索加密貨幣的基礎,並與當地冒著一切風險的加密貨幣先驅面談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we explore the foundations of Cryptocurrency and talk to the local crypto pioneers who risked it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在我們知道為何加密貨幣是何等大事,而我們在本集將認識紐西蘭最大的加密貨幣成功故事之一背後的家族.我們將破除一些加密神話並介紹如何參與的入門.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Now we know why Crypto is such a big deal, through this episode we』ll meet the family behind one of NZ’s biggest Crypto success stories. We』ll dispel some crypto myths and cover the basics of how to get on board.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執行長亞倫麥當勞和聯合創始人卜候活史密夫告訴我們他們如何在紐西蘭創立價值數百萬美元的非同質化代幣業務,並與國際巨星合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: CEO Aaron McDonald and Co-Founder Brooke Howard-Smith tell us how they created a multi-million dollar NFT business here in Aotearoa and are collaborating with international superstars.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德拜訪提姆.艾利斯--這位年輕執行長是相對論太空公司的創辦人,該公司打造並發射了全球第一枚3D列印火箭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Tim Ellis. A young CEO, Tim is the founder of Relativity Space, the company that built and launched the world’s first 3D printed rocket.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德獲得前所未有的機會,進入全球最神秘的藝術作品之一--詹姆斯.特瑞爾的〈羅登火山口〉.在這座火山口中,藝術以光與宇宙為題展開探索.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard are given unprecedented access to one of the world’s most guarded artworks: James Turrell’s Roden Crater. Inside the volcanic crater, the art explores the use of light and the cosmos.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見鞋履設計師歐瑪.貝利,他正改寫運動鞋文化.歐瑪的 FCTRY LAb 為音樂人與運動員創造創新鞋款,如今他將以 ARCH 為靈感設計全新靴子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Omar Bailey, a shoe designer revolutionizing sneaker culture. Omar’s FCTRY LAb has created innovative shoes for musicians and athletes. Now, he』ll create a boot inspired by ARCH.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德前往斯洛維尼亞,拜訪伊戈爾.阿克拉波維奇--一位為 MotoGP 傳奇車手打造排氣系統的工程師.隨著深入了解,ARCH 也將與他合作全新計畫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard travel to Slovenia to meet Igor Akrapovič. Igor’s company is an exhaust engineer known by MotoGP legends. As they learn from Igor, Arch will collaborate with him on a new project.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見享譽全球的雕塑家佩姬.布拉德利--她親手摧毀自己的藝術作品,只為創造全新的表達.透過火焰與想像,她揭示創作的真諦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Paige Bradley, a world-famous sculptor who destroyed her own art to create something new. Using fire and imagination, Paige offers insight into creativity and the artistic process.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂.羅德裡格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員.馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Mattie Rodrigue, the lead scientific researcher on OceanX. Mattie and her team explore the unknown ocean, and their work reveals how nature inspires everything we do.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅賓·威廉斯:笑容下的淚
epg.programme_title_en: Robin Williams: Laugh Until You Cry
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這位喜劇泰鬥有著令人驚嘆的頭腦,還有一系列讓我們嘖嘖稱奇的才華.他的故事激勵我們看穿那些看似擁有完美人生的人的面具. 他的精神將一直承傳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The comic genius with an electric mind, with a range of talent that left us breathless. His story inspires us to look past the mask of those people who seem to have a perfect life. His legacy lives on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬修派瑞因飾演昌德賓一角而深受觀眾喜愛,作為一位值得珍惜的老友和人,人們通過強調他在片場內外的喜劇遺產和個人奮鬥的珍藏片段緬懷他.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matthew Perry, beloved for his role as Chandler Bing, is remembered through archive footage highlighting his comedic legacy and personal struggles, both on and off set, as a cherished friend and human being.

epg.programme_title_en: John Cena: Champion Of The Ring
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊先拿在繼巨石強森- 狄維莊遜後轉戰好萊塢之前,叱吒摔角界十多年.無論是演戲還是摔跤,他都遵守自己的座右銘:努力,忠誠,尊重.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: John Cena dominated wrestling for over a decade before transitioning to Hollywood, following Dwayne The Rock Johnson. Whether acting or wrestling, he lives by his mantra: Hustle, Loyalty, and Respect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智慧.這是能震撼你的一集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見鞋履設計師歐瑪.貝利,他正改寫運動鞋文化.歐瑪的 FCTRY LAb 為音樂人與運動員創造創新鞋款,如今他將以 ARCH 為靈感設計全新靴子.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在東京廣闊的城市版圖中探索一種飲食文化,它不僅維持了工薪族的風格,還保留了其烹飪傳統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the vast urban sprawl of Tokyo, Adam Liaw explores a food culture that not only sustains the `salaryman workers in style but retains culinary traditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明查訪了一些東京的瘋狂美食餐廳,品嚐了一些有趣的菜式,包括用雞的生殖器官製成的日式烤雞串.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw checks out the restaurants of food-crazy Tokyo and tastes some interesting dishes including Yakitori made from the reproductive organs of chickens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師,一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐,一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力,溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往沖繩結束他的日本美食之旅,他在當地發現一道集大成的美食,並瞭解了長壽的秘訣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫南非美食之旅的第一站是繁華的開普敦.他在當地到訪熱鬧的農貿市場,並在 保卡烹調開普馬來咖哩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s first stop on his food trail of South Africa is the bustling city of Cape Town. Here, he visits a lively farmers market and cooks up a Cape Malay Curry in Bo Kaap.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫沿著南非海岸角繼續他的美食之旅,在抵達大森林私人自然保護區前,先到訪卡耶利沙黑人區,那裡是一些具啟發性的微型農業提案的集中地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren continues his food trail along South Africa’s Cape Coast, stopping off at the township of Khayelitsha, home to some inspiring micro-farming initiatives, before arriving at Grootbos Private Nature Reserve.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明尋找新加坡最好的海鮮.他從濱海灣金沙酒店出發,那裡有許多名廚開設的餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛頓熟食中心,繼續尋找海鮮靈感.他教授了如何安排一場獨一無二海鮮盛宴的大師班.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his search for seafood inspiration by heading to the famous Newton Food Centre. He gives a masterclass on how to line up a seafood feast like no other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從新加坡動物園的傳統早餐,包括咖央多士,溫泉蛋和咖啡開始,尋找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapores best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之旅的下一站是位於卡拉哈裡沙漠中心的提斯瓦魯豪華私人野生動物保護區.然後他遇到名廚馬努斯,烹製一些刺激的南非美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Tswalu Nature Reserve, in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. Warren then meets with acclaimed Chef Marnus to cook up some exciting South African delicacies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往沿海城市德班 - 住在標誌性的蠔盒酒店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the coastal city of Durban - where he’s staying at the iconic Oyster Box hotel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在德班,華倫先到訪著名的麥士生活品味餐廳,享受任性的祖魯烤肉體驗,再與當地導遊浮高碰面,參觀附近一條祖魯村莊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Durban, Warren visits the famous restaurant Max’s Lifestyle for an indulgent Shisa Nyama experience, before meeting with local guide Thoko to visit a nearby Zulu village.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之行的下一站是克魯格國家公園,南非其中一個最大的野生動物保護區,他住在著名的沙比沙比旅館.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa’s largest game reserves, where he’s staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在喀拉哈裡沙漠的中心發現無數的非洲動物,並學習製作傳統麵包乾來配早晨咖啡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Kalahari Desert, Warren spots a myriad of African animals, and learns to make traditional rusks to go with his morning coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapores best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美,最壯觀的亞洲遺產濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmars most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來認識這些異常的微型動物,牠們利用嬌小的身軀在世上最致命的環境中克險求生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the extraordinary miniature animals, who use their small size to survive against all odds in the world’s most deadly environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 體型異常龐大的動物就需要異常的適應力.從巨大的鯨魚到森林怪物,這些就是自然巨人的史詩式生存故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extraordinarily large animals need extraordinary adaptations. From mighty whales to forest monsters, these are the epic survival stories of nature’s giants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: They come in all shapes and sizes, are home to terrifying volcanoes, magnificent ancient civilizations, and some of the bluest waters on Earth. These are the fascinating worlds of Italys Islands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這裡擁有地中海一些最美麗的希臘神廟,似乎漂浮在海上的城市,還有地球上其中一個威力最大的火山,義大利這地區感覺就如平行世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With some of the most beautiful Greek temples on the Mediterranean, cities that just seem to float above the sea, and one of the most powerful volcanoes on Earth, this region of Italy feels like another world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
